questions.explanation: by the time+过去时（arrived），主句用过去完成时，表示在过去的某时间点之前已经完成的动作。会议在到达之前已经开始（持续10分钟），用had started。过去完成时结构：had+过去分词，表示'过去的过去'。by the time是过去完成时的标志。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态综合：by the time+过去时，主句用过去完成时had+done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 等他到达时，会议已经开始了十分钟。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The bridge ___ last year.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：这座桥是去年建的。
questions.explanation: 主语the bridge是build的承受者（桥被建造），用被动语态。last year是过去时间，用一般过去时的被动语态：was/were+过去分词。bridge是单数用was，build的过去分词是built。被动语态结构：be+过去分词，时态通过be动词体现。
questions.knowledgePoint: 被动语态：一般过去时被动was+built
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这座桥是去年建的。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: If I ___ you, I would not do that.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果我是你，我不会那样做。
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，if从句用过去时，be动词统一用were（不论人称）。主句用would+动词原形。If I were you=如果我是你（实际不是），与现在事实相反。虚拟语气中be动词的过去式一律用were，这是虚拟语气的特殊规则。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：与现在相反，if+过去时（be用were），主句would+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我是你，我不会那样做。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ was in 2020 that he graduated from college.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：正是在2020年他从大学毕业。
questions.explanation: 强调句结构：It is/was+被强调部分+that+其他。强调in 2020（时间状语）。It was...that...是强调句的标志。去掉It was和that后句子仍完整：He graduated from college in 2020。强调句可强调主语、宾语、状语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 强调句：It was+被强调部分+that+其他
questions.sentenceTranslation: 正是在2020年他从大学毕业。

questions.question: Choose the correct modal verb: You ___ be tired after working for ten hours.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确情态动词：你工作了十个小时，一定很累。
questions.explanation: must表肯定推测，意为'一定'。工作十小时后一定很累，有充分理由推断。情态动词表推测：must=一定（肯定推测），can't=不可能（否定推测），may/might=可能（不确定推测）。must表推测用于肯定句，can表推测用于否定/疑问句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 情态动词：must表肯定推测（一定）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你工作了十个小时，一定很累。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The man which is standing there is my uncle.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：站在那里的那个男人是我叔叔。
questions.explanation: 错误。先行词the man指人，作主语应用who/that，不能用which。正确：The man who/that is standing there is my uncle. which只能指物不能指人。关系代词选择：指人用who/that，指物用which/that。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：先行词指人作主语用who/that，不用which
questions.sentenceTranslation: 站在那里的那个男人是我叔叔。

questions.question: Judge true or false: He stopped to smoke because he had a cough.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：他因为咳嗽停止了抽烟。
questions.explanation: 错误。stop to smoke=停下来去抽烟，而因为咳嗽应该停止抽烟。正确应为stop smoking=停止抽烟。stop doing=停止正在做的事，stop to do=停下来去做另一件事。根据语境，咳嗽应停止抽烟，用stop smoking。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：stop doing（停止做）vs stop to do（停下来去做）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他因为咳嗽停止了抽烟。

questions.question: Judge true or false: I wish I am a bird.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我希望我是一只鸟。
questions.explanation: 错误。wish后用虚拟语气，与现在事实相反用过去时were。正确：I wish I were a bird. wish表示与事实相反的愿望，后接虚拟语气。与现在相反用过去时（be用were），与过去相反用had done。wish后不能用一般现在时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：wish后与现在相反用were，不用am
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我希望我是一只鸟。

questions.question: Judge true or false: English is speaking all over the world.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：全世界都说英语。
questions.explanation: 错误。English是被说的语言，用被动语态，且表示普遍状态用一般现在时。正确：English is spoken all over the world. 一般现在时被动语态：am/is/are+过去分词。speak的过去分词是spoken。is speaking是现在进行时主动语态，不正确。
questions.knowledgePoint: 被动语态：一般现在时被动is+spoken
questions.sentenceTranslation: 全世界都说英语。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The problem is ___ we don't have enough money.
questions.questionCn: 填空：问题是我们没有足够的钱。
questions.explanation: that引导表语从句，解释problem的内容（我们没有足够的钱）。that在名词性从句中只起连接作用，不作句子成分，但有连接功能。表语从句放在be动词之后，说明主语的内容。that引导表语从句时一般不省略。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词性从句：that引导表语从句（解释主语内容）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 问题是我们没有足够的钱。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The boy ___ (stand) under the tree is my brother.
questions.questionCn: 填空：站在树下的男孩是我弟弟。
questions.explanation: 现在分词standing作后置定语，修饰the boy，相当于定语从句who is standing under the tree。现在分词作定语表示主动和进行。the boy和stand是主动关系（男孩站着），用现在分词。过去分词作定语表被动。分词短语作定语放在被修饰词之后。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：现在分词standing作后置定语（表主动）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 站在树下的男孩是我弟弟。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Never ___ I seen such a beautiful sunset before.
questions.questionCn: 填空：以前我从未见过这么美的日落。
questions.explanation: Never是否定词，放句首时部分倒装，助动词have提前。正常语序：I have never seen...。部分倒装=助动词/情态动词/be动词提前到主语前。Never/Hardly/Seldom/Not only等否定词放句首引起部分倒装。现在完成时have seen表示到现在为止的经历。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与强调：Never放句首引起部分倒装have+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 以前我从未见过这么美的日落。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I ___ (live) here for ten years by next month.
questions.questionCn: 填空：到下个月我就已经在这里住了十年了。
questions.explanation: by next month（到下个月）是将来的时间点，用将来完成时。结构：will have+过去分词。将来完成时表示在将来某时间点之前完成的动作。live的过去分词是lived。by+将来时间常搭配将来完成时。for ten years表示持续到那个时间点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态综合：by+将来时间用将来完成时will have+done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 到下个月我就已经在这里住了十年了。

questions.question: Change to subjunctive mood: He doesn't know French, so he can't read this book.
questions.questionCn: 改为虚拟语气：他不懂法语，所以他不能读这本书。
questions.answer: If he knew French, he could read this book.
questions.explanation: 改为与现在事实相反的虚拟语气：if从句用过去时（knew），主句用would/could/might+动词原形（could read）。原句表示现在的事实（不懂法语），虚拟语气表示假设（如果懂法语就能读）。与现在相反的虚拟：if+过去时，主句would/could+原形。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：与现在相反，if+过去时，主句could+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他懂法语，他就能读这本书了。

questions.question: Combine the sentences using a relative clause: I met a woman. Her son is a famous actor.
questions.questionCn: 用定语从句合并句子：我遇到了一位女士。她的儿子是著名演员。
questions.answer: I met a woman whose son is a famous actor.
questions.explanation: 用whose引导定语从句，表所属关系（女人的儿子）。whose在定语从句中作定语修饰son，表示'她的（儿子）'。先行词a woman指人，与son是所属关系用whose。whose可指人指物，相当于of whom/of which。合并后表达更简洁。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：whose表所属关系引导定语从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我遇到了一位女士，她的儿子是著名演员。

questions.passage: Traveling abroad is a great way to broaden your horizons. Having learned about different cultures, you will understand the world better. To master a foreign language, you need to practice every day. Many people, inspired by travel stories, decide to explore the world themselves. When visiting a new country, it is important to respect local customs. Compared with staying at home, traveling offers more exciting experiences. Used wisely, travel can change your perspective on life.
questions.passageCn: 出国旅行是开阔视野的好方法。了解了不同的文化后，你会更好地理解这个世界。要掌握一门外语，你需要每天练习。许多人在旅行故事的启发下，决定自己去探索世界。到一个新国家时，尊重当地习俗很重要。与待在家里相比，旅行提供了更令人兴奋的体验。明智地利用的话，旅行能改变你对生活的看法。

subQuestions.question: What does 'Having learned about different cultures' function as?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'Having learned about different cultures'在句中作什么成分？
subQuestions.explanation: Having learned about different cultures是完成时态的现在分词短语，作时间/原因状语。having done表示先于主句动词完成的动作。先了解文化（having learned），然后更好地理解世界（will understand）。分词作状语，逻辑主语与主句主语一致（you）。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：having done作状语（表先于主句完成的动作）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 了解了不同的文化后，你会更好地理解这个世界。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'To master a foreign language' is used as an adverbial of purpose.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'To master a foreign language'用作目的状语。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。To master a foreign language是不定式短语，作目的状语，表示'为了掌握一门外语'。不定式作目的状语常放句首，可用in order to替换。to do表目的，doing表伴随，done表被动。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：不定式to do作目的状语
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 为了掌握一门外语，你需要每天练习。

questions.passage: The school where I study was founded fifty years ago. The principal, who is very strict but kind, always encourages students to work hard. The library, which has thousands of books, is my favorite place. Students whose grades are excellent can get scholarships. I still remember the day when I first came to this school. The teacher whom I respect most is my English teacher. The school that has produced many successful graduates makes me proud.
questions.passageCn: 我就读的学校建于五十年前。校长非常严格但很和蔼，总是鼓励学生努力学习。图书馆有数千本书，是我最喜欢的地方。成绩优秀的学生可以获得奖学金。我还记得我第一次来这所学校的那天。我最尊敬的老师是我的英语老师。这所学校培养了许多成功的毕业生，让我感到自豪。

subQuestions.question: What does 'where' refer to in 'The school where I study'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 在'The school where I study'中，where指代什么？
subQuestions.explanation: where引导定语从句修饰先行词the school，where是关系副词，在从句中作地点状语。where=at/in which（在那所学校里）。关系副词where引导定语从句修饰表示地点的名词。The school where I study=我学习的那所学校。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：关系副词where修饰地点名词
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 我就读的学校建于五十年前。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'whom I respect most' can be replaced by 'who' without changing meaning.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'whom I respect most'可以用who替换且不改变意思。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。whom在定语从句中作宾语（respect的宾语），现代英语中作宾语的whom可用who替换。whom是宾格形式，who是主格，但在非正式用法中who可作宾语。I respect whom/who=我尊敬的人。whom更正式，who更口语化。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：whom作宾语可用who替换
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 我最尊敬的老师是我的英语老师。

questions.question: ___ (walk) along the street, I met an old friend of mine.
questions.questionCn: 沿着街道走的时候，我遇到了一位老朋友。
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在分词作状语。句子主语I与walk是主动关系，且walk的动作与met同时发生，所以用现在分词Walking作伴随状语。现在分词作状语时，其逻辑主语必须与句子主语一致。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：现在分词作伴随状语（主动+同时）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 沿着街道走的时候，我遇到了一位老朋友。

questions.question: The book ___ (write) by Mo Yan is very popular among young people.
questions.questionCn: 莫言写的这本书很受年轻人欢迎。
questions.explanation: 本题考查过去分词作定语。book与write之间是被动关系（书被写），且write的动作已经完成，所以用过去分词written作后置定语修饰book。过去分词作定语表示被动和完成。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：过去分词作后置定语（被动+完成）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 莫言写的这本书很受年轻人欢迎。

questions.question: The teacher's words were a great ___ (encourage) to me.
questions.questionCn: 老师的话对我来说是极大的鼓励。
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。空格前有不定冠词a和形容词great，说明需要填名词。encourage是动词，其名词形式是encouragement（鼓励）。形容词great修饰名词encouragement。
questions.knowledgePoint: 词性转换：动词→名词（-ment后缀）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 老师的话对我来说是极大的鼓励。

questions.question: It is ___ (legal) to drive after drinking alcohol in China.
questions.questionCn: 在中国，酒后驾车是违法的。
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换和否定前缀。legal是形容词，意思是"合法的"。根据句意"酒后驾车"应该是"违法的"，所以需要加否定前缀il-变成illegal（非法的，违法的）。常见否定前缀：il-用于l开头的词，im-用于m/p开头的词，in-用于其他情况。
questions.knowledgePoint: 词性转换：形容词加否定前缀il-
questions.sentenceTranslation: 在中国，酒后驾车是违法的。

questions.question: I was about to go to bed ___ there was a knock at the door.
questions.questionCn: 我正要上床睡觉，这时有人敲门。
questions.explanation: 本题考查并列连词when的用法。句型be about to do...when...表示"正要做某事，这时（突然）…"。when在这里是并列连词，意为"这时，那时"，相当于and then/at that time。类似句型还有：was doing...when...（正在做…这时…），had done...when...（刚做完…这时…）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 连词：when作并列连词（be about to do...when...句型）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我正要上床睡觉，这时有人敲门。

questions.question: The Smiths don't usually like staying at ___ hotels, but last summer they spent a few days at a very nice hotel by the sea.
questions.questionCn: 史密斯一家通常不喜欢住酒店，但去年夏天他们在海边一家非常不错的酒店住了几天。
questions.explanation: 本题考查零冠词的用法。hotels是复数名词，表示泛指"酒店"这一类事物，前面不需要加冠词。at hotels表示"住酒店"这种泛指概念。如果特指某一家酒店则用定冠词the，如at the hotel。
questions.knowledgePoint: 冠词：复数名词表泛指用零冠词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 史密斯一家通常不喜欢住酒店，但去年夏天他们在海边一家非常不错的酒店住了几天。

questions.question: I'm sorry I didn't phone you, but I've been very busy ___ the past couple of weeks.
questions.questionCn: 很抱歉没有给你打电话，但过去几周我一直很忙。
questions.explanation: 本题考查介词用法。over the past couple of weeks表示"在过去的几周里"，常与现在完成时连用。over强调"贯穿整个期间"。这是现在完成时的标志性时间状语。类似表达还有in/during the past...weeks。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词：over + 时间段（现在完成时标志）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 很抱歉没有给你打电话，但过去几周我一直很忙。

questions.question: The two girls are so alike that strangers find ___ difficult to tell one from the other.
questions.questionCn: 这两个女孩长得太像了，陌生人发现很难把她们区分开。
questions.explanation: 本题考查it作形式宾语。句型find it + adj. + to do sth.中，it是形式宾语，真正的宾语是后面的不定式to tell one from the other。it作形式宾语可以避免句子头重脚轻。类似的动词还有：think, feel, make, consider等。
questions.knowledgePoint: 代词：it作形式宾语（find it + adj. + to do）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这两个女孩长得太像了，陌生人发现很难把她们区分开。

questions.question: In the last few years, thousands of films ___ (produce) all over the world.
questions.questionCn: 在过去的几年里，全世界制作了成千上万部电影。
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时的被动语态。时间状语in the last few years（在过去几年里）是现在完成时的标志。films与produce之间是被动关系（电影被制作），所以用现在完成时被动语态have/has been + 过去分词。主语films是复数，所以用have been produced。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态语态：现在完成时被动语态（have been done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 在过去的几年里，全世界制作了成千上万部电影。

questions.question: The result is not very important to us, but if we do win, then so much the ___ (good).
questions.questionCn: 结果对我们来说不是很重要，但如果我们真的赢了，那就更好了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词比较级的特殊用法。句型so much the better表示"那就更好了"，是固定表达。the + 比较级常用来表示"越…就越…"或"那就更…了"。类似表达：so much the worse（那就更糟了）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词副词：比较级特殊结构so much the better
questions.sentenceTranslation: 结果对我们来说不是很重要，但如果我们真的赢了，那就更好了。

questions.question: The old town has narrow streets and small houses ___ are built close to each other.
questions.questionCn: 这座老城镇有狭窄的街道和紧挨在一起建造的小房子。
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词。先行词是small houses（指物），关系代词在从句中作主语，所以用that或which。that和which在定语从句中作主语时不能省略。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：关系代词that/which指代物作主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这座老城镇有狭窄的街道和紧挨在一起建造的小房子。

questions.question: ___ Barbara Jones offers to her fans is honesty and happiness.
questions.questionCn: 芭芭拉·琼斯带给她粉丝的是诚实和快乐。
questions.explanation: 本题考查主语从句的引导词。what引导主语从句，在从句中作offers的宾语。what=the thing(s) that，表示"…的东西/事情"。主语从句位于句首时，what不能省略。that引导主语从句时不在从句中作成分，也没有实际含义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词性从句：what引导主语从句（在从句中作宾语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 芭芭拉·琼斯带给她粉丝的是诚实和快乐。

questions.question: Please call my secretary to arrange a meeting this afternoon, or whenever it is ___ (convenience) to you.
questions.questionCn: 请打电话给我的秘书安排今天下午的会议，或者你方便的任何时候。
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换和固定句型。it is convenient to sb.表示"对某人来说方便"。convenience是名词，需要变成形容词convenient作表语。注意：convenient的主语不能是人，只能是it或事物。
questions.knowledgePoint: 词性转换：名词→形容词（-t后缀）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请打电话给我的秘书安排今天下午的会议，或者你方便的任何时候。

questions.question: More highways have been built in China, ___ (make) it much easier for people to travel from one place to another.
questions.questionCn: 中国修建了更多的高速公路，使得人们从一个地方到另一个地方旅行变得更加容易。
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在分词作结果状语。前面说"修建了更多高速公路"，后面是自然而然的结果"使得旅行更容易"，所以用现在分词making作结果状语。现在分词作结果状语表示顺其自然的结果；不定式作结果状语常表示出乎意料的结果，前面常加only。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：现在分词作结果状语（顺其自然的结果）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 中国修建了更多的高速公路，使得人们从一个地方到另一个地方旅行变得更加容易。

questions.question: I ___ have worried before I came to the new school, for my classmates here are very friendly to me.
questions.questionCn: 我来新学校之前本不必担心的，因为这里的同学对我都很友好。
questions.explanation: 本题考查情态动词+have done的用法。needn't have done表示"本不必做某事（但实际上做了）"，是对过去已发生事情的委婉责备或评论。根据句意"同学们都很友好"，说明担心是多余的。类似结构：shouldn't have done（本不该做却做了），could have done（本可以做却没做）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 情态动词：needn't have done（本不必做却做了）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我来新学校之前本不必担心的，因为这里的同学对我都很友好。

questions.question: Her ___ (motivate) for writing was a desire for women to get the right to higher education.
questions.questionCn: 她写作的动机是渴望女性获得接受高等教育的权利。
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。空格前有形容词性物主代词her，说明需要填名词。motivate是动词，意思是"激励，激发"，其名词形式是motivation（动机，动力）。-tion是常见的名词后缀。
questions.knowledgePoint: 词性转换：动词→名词（-tion后缀）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她写作的动机是渴望女性获得接受高等教育的权利。

questions.question: Have you ever heard of the trees that are homes ___ animals both on land and sea?
questions.questionCn: 你听说过既是陆地动物又是海洋动物家园的树吗？
questions.explanation: 本题考查介词搭配。be home to是固定搭配，意为"是…的家园/栖息地"，相当于be the home of。类似的搭配还有：be friendly to（对…友好），be harmful to（对…有害），be important to（对…重要）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词：be home to 固定搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你听说过既是陆地动物又是海洋动物家园的树吗？

questions.question: Opposite is St. Paul's Church, ___ you can hear some lovely music.
questions.questionCn: 对面是圣保罗教堂，在那里你可以听到一些美妙的音乐。
questions.explanation: 本题考查非限制性定语从句。先行词是St. Paul's Church（表示地点），从句中缺少地点状语，所以用关系副词where引导非限制性定语从句。where在从句中作地点状语，相当于in which。非限制性定语从句不能用that引导。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：where引导非限制性定语从句（作地点状语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 对面是圣保罗教堂，在那里你可以听到一些美妙的音乐。

questions.question: If the new safety system ___ (put) to use, the accident would never have happened.
questions.questionCn: 如果新的安全系统投入使用的话，这起事故就不会发生了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气。根据主句would never have happened可知是对过去情况的虚拟，从句应该用had done形式。又因为system和put之间是被动关系（系统被投入使用），所以用过去完成时被动语态had been put。对过去虚拟的结构：if + 主语 + had been done, 主语 + would/could/might have done。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：对过去情况的虚拟（从句had been done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果新的安全系统投入使用的话，这起事故就不会发生了。

questions.question: We choose this hotel because the price for a night here is down to $20, half of ___ it used to charge.
questions.questionCn: 我们选择这家酒店是因为这里住一晚的价格降到了20美元，是以前价格的一半。
questions.explanation: 本题考查宾语从句。half of后面接宾语从句，从句中charge缺少宾语，所以用what引导宾语从句并在从句中作宾语。what=the price that，表示"…的价格"。注意：half of + what从句是常见结构，表示"是…的一半"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词性从句：what引导宾语从句（作介词of的宾语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们选择这家酒店是因为这里住一晚的价格降到了20美元，是以前价格的一半。

questions.question: The government has taken measures to ___ the price of daily necessities.
questions.questionCn: 政府已经采取措施来___日用品的价格。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。bring down意为"降低，使下降"，bring down the price即"降低价格"，符合句意。put down意为"放下；写下；镇压"；turn down意为"拒绝；调小（音量）"；take down意为"记下；拆卸"。高考高频短语：bring about（引起），bring up（抚养；提出），bring in（引进；赚得）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词短语辨析：bring相关短语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 政府已经采取措施来降低日用品的价格。

questions.question: The teacher gave us a clear ___ of the experiment before we did it.
questions.questionCn: 在我们做实验之前，老师给了我们清晰的___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。instruction意为"指导，说明，操作指南"，a clear instruction of the experiment即"清晰的实验指导"，符合语境。introduction意为"介绍；引言"；invitation意为"邀请"；invention意为"发明"。这四个词词形相近，是高考完形填空的高频易混词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：-tion结尾易混名词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 在我们做实验之前，老师给了我们清晰的实验指导。

questions.question: Although the cat is old, it is still very ___ when it comes to catching mice.
questions.questionCn: 虽然这只猫老了，但在抓老鼠方面它仍然非常___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。active意为"活跃的，积极的"，still very active即"仍然非常活跃"，符合语境。alive意为"活着的"；awake意为"醒着的"；alone意为"独自的"。a-开头的形容词通常作表语，不作前置定语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词辨析：a-开头表语形容词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 虽然这只猫老了，但在抓老鼠方面它仍然非常活跃。

questions.question: She was ___ to hear that her application for the scholarship had been accepted.
questions.questionCn: 她___得知自己的奖学金申请被接受了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。relieved是形容词化的过去分词，意为"放心的，宽慰的"，be relieved to do sth.表示"做某事感到放心/宽慰"。release意为"释放；发布"；reflect意为"反映；反思"；refuse意为"拒绝"。re-前缀的动词是高考完形高频考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：re-前缀动词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她得知自己的奖学金申请被接受了，感到很宽慰。

questions.question: The task was difficult, but ___ we managed to finish it on time.
questions.questionCn: 任务很困难，但___我们设法按时完成了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。somehow意为"以某种方式，不知怎么地"，表示"通过某种途径成功做到"，符合句意。however意为"然而"（注意but不能与however连用）；otherwise意为"否则"；therefore意为"因此"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 副词辨析：连接性副词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 任务很困难，但我们以某种方式设法按时完成了。

questions.question: The doctor told me to ___ my health problem seriously and take the medicine on time.
questions.questionCn: 医生告诉我要认真___我的健康问题，按时吃药。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词搭配。take sth. seriously是固定搭配，意为"认真对待某事"。这是高考完形填空的高频搭配。类似搭配：take...for granted（认为...理所当然），take advantage of（利用），take care of（照顾）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词搭配：take相关固定搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 医生告诉我要认真对待我的健康问题，按时吃药。

questions.question: The city has changed so much that I can hardly ___ it.
questions.questionCn: 这座城市变化太大了，我几乎不能___它。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。recognize意为"认出，识别出"，can hardly recognize it即"几乎认不出来了"，符合"变化大"的语境。realize意为"意识到；实现"；recommend意为"推荐"；remain意为"保持；剩下"。re-开头的动词是高考完形的必考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：re-前缀易混动词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这座城市变化太大了，我几乎认不出来了。

questions.question: It is ___ of you to bring an umbrella with you on such a cloudy day.
questions.questionCn: 你在这样的阴天带伞真___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。sensible意为"明智的，理智的"，it is sensible of sb. to do sth.表示"某人做某事是明智的"。sensitive意为"敏感的"；sensational意为"耸人听闻的；轰动的"；sentimental意为"多愁善感的"。sens-开头的形容词是高考高频易混词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词辨析：sens-开头易混形容词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你在这样的阴天带伞真明智。

questions.question: I waited for an hour, but he never ___. What happened to him?
questions.questionCn: 我等了一个小时，但他一直没有___。他怎么了？
questions.explanation: 本题考查turn相关动词短语。turn up意为"出现，到场；调大（音量）"，这里表示"出现，露面"。turn down意为"拒绝；调小"；turn over意为"翻转；移交"；turn out意为"结果是；证明是"。turn短语是高考完形填空的最高频考点之一。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词短语辨析：turn相关短语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我等了一个小时，但他一直没有出现。他怎么了？

questions.question: The new law will come into ___ on the day it is passed.
questions.questionCn: 新法律将在通过之日起___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词与动词搭配。come into effect是固定搭配，意为"生效，开始实施"，常用于法律、法规、政策等。come into use意为"开始被使用"；come into service意为"投入使用"；come into existence意为"开始存在，产生"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词搭配：come into effect 固定搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 新法律将在通过之日起生效。

questions.question: He was in hospital for six months. He felt as if he was ___ from the outside world.
questions.questionCn: 他住了六个月院。他感觉自己好像与外界___了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查cut相关短语。cut off意为"切断，隔绝"，cut off from the outside world即"与外界隔绝"。cut out意为"删去；停止"；cut up意为"切碎"；cut down意为"砍倒；削减"。cut短语是高考完形高频考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词短语辨析：cut相关短语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他住了六个月院。他感觉自己好像与外界隔绝了。

questions.question: The book is ___ for children because it contains too much violence.
questions.questionCn: 这本书不___儿童阅读，因为它包含太多暴力内容。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。unfit意为"不合适的，不适合的"，be unfit for表示"不适合…"。unimportant意为"不重要的"；unable意为"不能的"（be unable to do sth.）；uncertain意为"不确定的"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词辨析：un-前缀形容词搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这本书不适合儿童阅读，因为它包含太多暴力内容。

questions.question: I don't think I'll need any money but I'll bring some just ___.
questions.questionCn: 我觉得我不需要钱，但我还是带一些以防万一。
questions.explanation: 本题考查介词短语辨析。in case意为"以防万一，免得"，作状语时放在句末，just in case是常用表达。in advance意为"提前"；in return意为"作为回报"；in total意为"总共"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词短语辨析：in + 名词短语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我觉得我不需要钱，但我还是带一些以防万一。

questions.question: The manager asked his assistant to prepare a full ___ on last month's sales.
questions.questionCn: 经理让他的助手准备一份关于上月销售情况的完整___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。report意为"报告，汇报"，a full report on...即"关于...的完整报告"。notice意为"通知，公告"；message意为"消息，信息"；suggestion意为"建议"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：信息类名词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 经理让他的助手准备一份关于上月销售情况的完整报告。

questions.question: After several rounds of talks, the two sides finally ___ an agreement.
questions.questionCn: 经过几轮谈判，双方最终___了协议。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词搭配。reach an agreement是固定搭配，意为"达成协议"。reach是及物动词，可以直接加宾语。arrive是不及物动词，需要加at（arrive at an agreement）。"达成协议"：reach an agreement = arrive at an agreement = come to an agreement。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词搭配：reach an agreement 达成协议
questions.sentenceTranslation: 经过几轮谈判，双方最终达成了协议。

questions.question: You are so busy recently. I ___ hope you can take some time to rest.
questions.questionCn: 你最近太忙了。我___希望你能抽点时间休息。
questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。sincerely意为"真诚地，衷心地"，I sincerely hope...即"我真诚地希望…"。seriously意为"严肃地，认真地"；strictly意为"严格地"；slightly意为"稍微地"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 副词辨析：情感/程度副词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你最近太忙了。我真诚地希望你能抽点时间休息。

questions.question: The firemen tried their best to ___ the fire before it spread to other buildings.
questions.questionCn: 消防员尽最大努力在火势蔓延到其他建筑之前___大火。
questions.explanation: 本题考查put相关动词短语。put out意为"扑灭（火）；出版"，put out the fire即"扑灭大火"。put off意为"推迟"；put up意为"举起；张贴；建造"；put away意为"收好，放好"。put短语是高考完形填空的最高频考点之一。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词短语辨析：put相关短语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 消防员尽最大努力在火势蔓延到其他建筑之前扑灭大火。

questions.question: The little girl has a great ___ for music. She plays the piano very well.
questions.questionCn: 这个小女孩很有音乐___。她钢琴弹得很好。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。talent意为"天赋，才能"，have a talent for是固定搭配，意为"在…方面有天赋"。taste意为"品味；味道"；sense意为"感觉；意识"（a sense of humor 幽默感）；ability意为"能力"（have the ability to do sth.）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：have a talent for 固定搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这个小女孩很有音乐天赋。她钢琴弹得很好。

questions.question: The speaker ___ his speech with a famous saying from Einstein.
questions.questionCn: 演讲者用爱因斯坦的一句名言___了他的演讲。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。conclude意为"结束，得出结论"，conclude...with...表示"以...结束..."。continue意为"继续"；conduct意为"进行；指挥"；convince意为"使信服"。con-开头的动词是高考完形高频考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：con-前缀动词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 演讲者用爱因斯坦的一句名言结束了他的演讲。

questions.question: Although they are twins, they have little in common in terms of ___.
questions.questionCn: 虽然他们是双胞胎，但在___方面几乎没有共同之处。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。personality意为"性格，个性"，have little in common in terms of personality即"在性格方面几乎没有共同点"。popularity意为"流行，人气"；possibility意为"可能性"；prosperity意为"繁荣"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：-ity结尾易混名词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 虽然他们是双胞胎，但在性格方面几乎没有共同之处。

questions.passage: Can you imagine a world without the Internet? It's surprising to think about it. Now, China has more than 160 million Internet users, according to the China Internet Network Information Center. This is the second highest number of users in the world after the United States. Today, 66% of Chinese 'netizens' are teenagers. 'They spend about thirteen hours every week online,' said Qian Hulin, an Internet expert. The main reasons why teenagers surf the Web are to search for information, to communicate with others and to have fun. On the Internet, teenagers can find out almost anything. And surfing the Web can help students with their homework and widen their knowledge. However, some parents don't think it's good for their children's health. They worry that their children spend too much time online and don't have enough time to study. Experts say that parents should limit their children's screen time and encourage them to use the Internet wisely.
questions.passageCn: 你能想象一个没有互联网的世界吗？想想都令人惊讶。根据中国互联网络信息中心的数据，现在中国有超过1.6亿互联网用户。这是仅次于美国的世界第二大用户数量。如今，66%的中国"网民"是青少年。互联网专家钱虎林说："他们每周大约花13个小时上网。"青少年上网的主要原因是搜索信息、与他人交流和娱乐。在互联网上，青少年几乎可以找到任何东西。而且上网可以帮助学生完成家庭作业，拓宽他们的知识面。然而，一些家长认为这对孩子的健康不利。他们担心孩子花太多时间上网，没有足够的时间学习。专家表示，家长应该限制孩子的屏幕时间，鼓励他们明智地使用互联网。

subQuestions.question: According to the passage, which country has the most Internet users?
subQuestions.questionCn: 根据文章，哪个国家的互联网用户最多？
subQuestions.explanation: 根据原文：'This is the second highest number of users in the world after the United States.'（这是仅次于美国的世界第二大用户数量），可知美国用户最多，中国第二。after在这里表示"仅次于"。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 细节理解题：比较级与排名
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 这是仅次于美国的世界第二大用户数量。

subQuestions.question: What does the underlined word 'netizens' in Paragraph 1 probably mean?
subQuestions.questionCn: 第一段中划线的'netizens'一词可能是什么意思？
choices: A. People who use the Internet
B. People who like playing games
C. People who work in IT companies
subQuestions.explanation: 词义猜测题。根据上下文：'China has more than 160 million Internet users...66% of Chinese netizens are teenagers.' 可以推断netizens指的是Internet users（互联网用户/网民）。netizen是net（网络）和citizen（公民）的合成词。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 词义猜测题：合成词推断
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 如今，66%的中国'网民'是青少年。

subQuestions.question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a reason why teenagers surf the Web?
subQuestions.questionCn: 以下哪一项没有被提到是青少年上网的原因？
subQuestions.explanation: 根据原文：'The main reasons why teenagers surf the Web are to search for information, to communicate with others and to have fun.' 文中提到了三个原因：搜索信息、与他人交流和娱乐。没有提到看电影。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 细节理解题：排除法
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 青少年上网的主要原因是搜索信息、与他人交流和娱乐。

subQuestions.question: True or False: All parents think the Internet is harmful to their children's health.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：所有家长都认为互联网对孩子的健康有害。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。原文说'some parents don't think it's good for their children's health'（一些家长认为这对孩子健康不利），是'some'（一些）而不是'all'（所有）。这是高考阅读理解常见的陷阱——以偏概全。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 推理判断题：范围词陷阱（some vs all）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 一些家长认为这对孩子的健康不利。

subQuestions.question: What is the experts' suggestion to parents?
subQuestions.questionCn: 专家对家长的建议是什么？
choices: A. Let children use the Internet as much as they want
B. Limit children's screen time and encourage wise use
C. Never allow children to use the Internet
D. Only let children use the Internet for study
subQuestions.explanation: 根据原文最后一句：'Experts say that parents should limit their children's screen time and encourage them to use the Internet wisely.' 专家建议家长应该限制孩子的屏幕时间，鼓励他们明智地使用互联网。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 细节理解题：专家建议类
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 专家表示，家长应该限制孩子的屏幕时间，鼓励他们明智地使用互联网。

questions.passage: Plastic bags have caused serious environmental problems all over the world. Every year, millions of plastic bags are used and thrown away. They take hundreds of years to break down. They pollute the soil and water, and are dangerous to animals. Many countries have realized the problem and taken action. In China, a ban on thin plastic bags was introduced in 2008. Supermarkets and shops were stopped from giving free plastic bags to customers. The ban has worked well in reducing plastic waste. However, plastic bags are still widely used in small shops and markets. To solve this problem, we need to change people's habits. People should be encouraged to bring their own reusable bags when shopping. Some cities have started to encourage the use of cloth bags and baskets. Schools also teach children about the importance of protecting the environment. If everyone does their part, we can make a big difference.
questions.passageCn: 塑料袋在全世界造成了严重的环境问题。每年有数以百万计的塑料袋被使用和丢弃。它们需要数百年才能分解。它们污染土壤和水，对动物也很危险。许多国家已经意识到这个问题并采取了行动。在中国，2008年出台了一项禁止使用薄塑料袋的规定。超市和商店被禁止向顾客提供免费塑料袋。这项禁令在减少塑料垃圾方面效果很好。然而，塑料袋在小商店和市场上仍然被广泛使用。为了解决这个问题，我们需要改变人们的习惯。应该鼓励人们购物时自带可重复使用的袋子。一些城市已经开始鼓励使用布袋和篮子。学校也教孩子们保护环境的重要性。如果每个人都尽自己的一份力，我们就能产生很大的影响。

subQuestions.question: How long does it take for plastic bags to break down?
subQuestions.questionCn: 塑料袋需要多长时间才能分解？
subQuestions.explanation: 根据原文：'They take hundreds of years to break down.'（它们需要数百年才能分解）。这是细节理解题。take some time to do sth. 表示"花费多长时间做某事"。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 细节理解题：数字类
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 它们需要数百年才能分解。

subQuestions.question: When was the ban on thin plastic bags introduced in China?
subQuestions.questionCn: 中国什么时候出台了禁止使用薄塑料袋的规定？
subQuestions.explanation: 根据原文：'In China, a ban on thin plastic bags was introduced in 2008.'（在中国，2008年出台了一项禁止使用薄塑料袋的规定）。这是细节理解题，考查时间信息。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 细节理解题：时间类
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 在中国，2008年出台了一项禁止使用薄塑料袋的规定。

subQuestions.question: True or False: The ban on plastic bags has completely solved the problem in China.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：中国的塑料袋禁令已经完全解决了这个问题。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。原文说'The ban has worked well in reducing plastic waste. However, plastic bags are still widely used in small shops and markets.' 说明问题还没有完全解决。completely（完全地）过于绝对，是阅读理解常见的错误选项特征。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 推理判断题：绝对化词语陷阱
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 然而，塑料袋在小商店和市场上仍然被广泛使用。

subQuestions.question: What does the underlined word 'reusable' in the passage mean?
subQuestions.questionCn: 文中划线的'reusable'一词是什么意思？
subQuestions.explanation: 词义猜测题。reusable是由use（使用）+ -able（能够...的）+ re-（再，重新）构成的，re-前缀表示"再，又，重新"，-able后缀表示"能够...的"，所以reusable意为"可重复使用的"。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 词义猜测题：前缀re- + 后缀-able
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 应该鼓励人们购物时自带可重复使用的袋子。

subQuestions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
subQuestions.questionCn: 这篇文章的主旨是什么？
choices: A. How plastic bags are made
B. The history of plastic bags
C. Plastic bag pollution and ways to solve it
D. Why people like using plastic bags
subQuestions.explanation: 主旨大意题。文章先讲了塑料袋造成的环境问题，然后讲了各国采取的措施，最后呼吁大家改变习惯、使用环保袋。所以主旨是"塑料袋污染及解决方法"。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 主旨大意题：概括全文中心思想
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 如果每个人都尽自己的一份力，我们就能产生很大的影响。

cet4.name: 四级
cet4.description: 四级综合运用：从句嵌套、非谓语进阶、虚拟进阶、倒装综合、固定搭配与长难句结构分析，以句法结构为主线提升应试能力。v3.0.0新增词汇解析、全句翻译及阅读理解题型。
focus: 从句综合（同位语vs定语/多重嵌套）
非谓语进阶（独立主格/分词状语/不定式完成式）
虚拟进阶（would rather/it is time/suggest后虚拟）
倒装综合（only/否定词/as让步倒装）
固定搭配与介词（动+介/形+介/名+介）
长难句结构分析（主干/修饰/插入语）
时态与语态综合（完成进行/将来完成/被动进行）
特殊句式（强调句/省略句/替代/反义疑问）

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The news ___ our team had won the game made us excited.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：我们队赢了比赛的消息让我们很兴奋。
questions.explanation: 同位语从句，that解释news的内容（我们队赢了），that只起连接作用不作成分。同位语从句vs定语从句：同位语从句that不作成分且不可省；定语从句that作主/宾语可省。同位语从句解释名词内容。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：同位语从句that（解释名词内容，不作成分）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们队赢了比赛的消息让我们很兴奋。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___, we went home.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：工作完成后，我们就回家了。
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构The work finished中work与finish是被动关系，用过去分词。独立主格=名词/代词+分词，自身有逻辑主语，作状语。work是逻辑主语，finish被动→finished。独立主格表时间/原因/条件等。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：独立主格结构（名词+过去分词，表被动）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 工作完成后，我们就回家了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ from the top of the hill, the city looks beautiful.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：从山顶上看，这座城市很美。
questions.explanation: 分词作状语，主句主语the city与see是被动关系（城市被看），用过去分词Seen。分词作状语看与主句主语关系：主动用doing，被动用done。Seeing→主动看，Seen→被看。城市是被看的对象，用Seen。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：分词作状语，被动用过去分词Seen
questions.sentenceTranslation: 从山顶上看，这座城市很美。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: I would rather you ___ tomorrow.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我宁愿你明天来。
questions.explanation: would rather后接从句用虚拟语气，与现在/将来相反用过去式。would rather+主语+过去式（表对现在/将来的虚拟）。would rather do=宁愿做（主语相同），would rather sb did=宁愿某人做（从句虚拟）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟进阶：would rather后从句用过去式虚拟
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我宁愿你明天来。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Only then ___ the importance of English.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：那时我才意识到英语的重要性。
questions.explanation: Only+状语置于句首，主句部分倒装：助动词提到主语前。did I realize=助动词did提到主语I前。Only then/Only in this way/Only when开头，主句倒装。部分倒装：助动词/情态/be提到主语前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：Only+状语开头部分倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 那时我才意识到英语的重要性。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is familiar ___ French literature.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确介词：她熟悉法国文学。
questions.explanation: be familiar with=熟悉...（人作主语，主动熟悉）。be familiar to=为...所熟悉（物作主语）。形容词+介词搭配需记忆：familiar with/to, good at, afraid of, interested in, proud of。She熟悉法国文学→with。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be familiar with（人作主语主动熟悉）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她熟悉法国文学。

questions.question: Identify the main clause: The book that I bought yesterday, which cost me 50 yuan, is very interesting. What is the main clause?
questions.questionCn: 识别主干：The book that I bought yesterday, which cost me 50 yuan, is very interesting. 主句是？
choices: A. The book that I bought yesterday
C. The book is very interesting
questions.explanation: 主句主干是The book is very interesting。that I bought yesterday是限制性定语从句修饰book；which cost me 50 yuan是非限制性定语从句（插入语）。长难句分析先找主干，剥离从句和插入语。逗号间为非限制性定语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：识别主干（剥离定语从句和插入语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我昨天买的、花了我50元的那本书很有趣。

questions.question: Choose the correct tense: By the end of this year, I ___ here for ten years.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确时态：到今年年底，我在这里就十年了。
questions.explanation: by the end of this year（将来时间），用将来完成时will have done。将来完成时表到将来某时已完成。结构：will have+过去分词。对比：by the end of last year用过去完成时had done。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态语态综合：将来完成时will have done（by+将来时间）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 到今年年底，我在这里就工作十年了。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: It was not until midnight ___ he came back.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：直到午夜他才回来。
questions.explanation: It is/was not until...that...是强调句型，强调not until时间状语。that是强调句连接词。强调句It is/was+被强调部分+that+其余。not until强调句是固定考点：It was not until...that...=直到...才...。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：It is not until...that...强调句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到午夜他才回来。

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: Let's go for a walk, ___?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确反义疑问尾句：我们去散步吧，好吗？
questions.explanation: Let's开头祈使句，反义疑问句用shall we。反义疑问句规则：Let's→shall we；Let us/Let me→will you；一般祈使句→will you。Let's表建议，含说话人→shall we。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：Let's反义疑问句用shall we
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们去散步吧，好吗？

questions.question: Judge true or false: In 'The news that he told us is true.', the word 'that' can be omitted.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：在'The news that he told us is true.'中，that可以省略。
questions.explanation: 正确。that引导定语从句，在从句中作told的宾语（told us the news→told us that），作宾语时可省略。定语从句that作宾语可省。对比同位语从句：'The news that he won is true'中that不作成分不可省。判断关键：that在从句中是否作成分。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：定语从句that作宾语可省 vs 同位语从句that不可省
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他告诉我们的消息是真的。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Having been told many times, he still made the same mistake.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：被告知了许多次之后，他还是犯了同样的错误。
questions.explanation: 正确。Having been told是现在分词完成被动式，表被动且先于主句发生。he与tell是被动关系（被告知），且告知发生在犯错之前。Having been done=完成被动，作状语表'已被...之后'。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：现在分词完成被动式Having been done作状语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 被告知了许多次之后，他还是犯了同样的错误。

questions.question: Judge true or false: It is high time that we go home.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我们该回家了。
questions.explanation: 错误。It is (high) time that+从句用虚拟语气，动词用过去式或should do。正确：It is high time that we went home. It is (high) time that sb did/should do=是某人该做...的时候了。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟进阶：It is (high) time that+从句用过去式/should do
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们该回家了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: He is responsible of the accident.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：他对这起事故负责。
questions.explanation: 错误。be responsible for=对...负责，用for不用of。正确：He is responsible for the accident. 形容词+介词固定搭配：responsible for, famous for, full of, afraid of。responsible搭配for非of。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be responsible for（介词用for非of）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他对这起事故负责。

questions.question: Judge true or false: In 'The man, who was wearing a black coat, suddenly left.', 'who was wearing a black coat' is a non-restrictive relative clause.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：在'The man, who was wearing a black coat, suddenly left.'中，who was wearing a black coat是非限制性定语从句。
questions.explanation: 正确。逗号间的who was wearing a black coat是非限制性定语从句，补充说明the man。非限制性定语从句特点：用逗号隔开，补充说明，不可用that（指人用who，指物用which）。限制性无逗号，非限制性有逗号。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：非限制性定语从句（逗号隔开，不可用that）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 那个穿着黑色外套的男人突然离开了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The room is being cleaned now.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：房间正在被打扫。
questions.explanation: 正确。现在进行时被动is being done表此刻正在被做。is being cleaned=正在被打扫。被动进行时结构：am/is/are being done（现在），was/were being done（过去）。now提示正在进行。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态语态综合：现在进行时被动is being done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 房间正在被打扫。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I will give this book to ___ wants to read it.
questions.questionCn: 填空：谁想读这本书，我就把它给谁。
questions.explanation: 介词to后接宾语从句，'wants to read it'缺主语，用whoever（=anyone who）。whoever既作to的宾语又作从句主语。what/who/whoever等引导宾语从句须在从句中作成分。whoever比anyone who更简洁。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：whoever引导宾语从句（=anyone who）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 谁想读这本书，我就把它给谁。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is said ___ (write) a new book recently.
questions.questionCn: 填空：据说他最近写了一本新书。
questions.explanation: It is said that结构变体：sb is said to do。write发生在is said之前（已完成），用不定式完成式to have done。to have written=已经写了。不定式完成式to have done表动作发生在谓语之前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：不定式完成式to have done（表先于谓语完成）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他最近写了一本新书。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ had she finished the test when the bell rang.
questions.questionCn: 填空：她刚做完试卷铃就响了。
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...固定结构，否定词开头部分倒装。No sooner had she finished...than...=她刚做完就...。had提到she前=部分倒装。No sooner...than、Hardly...when表'一...就...'。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：No sooner...than开头部分倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她刚做完试卷铃就响了。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: We should focus ___ our studies.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们应该专注于学习。
questions.explanation: focus on=集中于，动词+介词搭配。focus接on表'集中于...'。动词+介词搭配需记忆：focus on, depend on, rely on, insist on, result in。on表'在...上/关于'。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：focus on（动词+介词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们应该专注于学习。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is the only one of the students who ___ (be) from China.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他是学生中唯一来自中国的。
questions.explanation: 'the only one of+复数名词+定语从句'中，从句谓语与the only one一致用单数。the only one是核心主语→is。'one of+复数名词+定语从句'则用复数。判断关键：the only one of→单数；one of→复数。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：the only one of结构从句谓语用单数
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他是学生中唯一来自中国的。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: If you don't want to go, ___ do I.
questions.questionCn: 填空：如果你不想去，我也不去。
questions.explanation: neither+助动词/be/情态+主语=某人也不。前句否定，后句用neither倒装表'也不'。neither do I=我也不。对比肯定用So do I。结构：Neither+be/助/情+主语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：neither倒装表'也不'
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果你不想去，我也不去。

questions.question: Combine into one sentence: I don't know the reason. He was late for the reason.
questions.questionCn: 合并为一句：我不知道原因。他因为这个原因迟到了。
questions.answer: I don't know the reason why he was late.
questions.explanation: the reason后接定语从句，表原因用why（=for which）。why是关系副词，引导定语从句修饰reason。结构：the reason+why+从句。why=for which。也可省略why：I don't know the reason he was late.
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：the reason why引导定语从句（why=for which）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我不知道他迟到的原因。

questions.question: Correct the error: The doctor suggested that he takes more exercise.
questions.questionCn: 改错：医生建议他多锻炼。
questions.answer: The doctor suggested that he (should) take more exercise.
questions.explanation: suggest/demand/insist/order/require等表'建议/要求'的动词后宾语从句用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。suggest后用(should) take，不用takes。这类动词的宾语从句谓语用should do（should可省）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟进阶：suggest/demand后宾语从句用(should)+动词原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 医生建议他多锻炼。

questions.question: Rewrite with 'as' inversion: Though he is young, he knows a lot.
questions.questionCn: 用as倒装改写：虽然他年轻，但他懂得很多。
questions.answer: Young as he is, he knows a lot.
questions.explanation: as引导让步状语从句倒装：adj/adv/n+as+主语+谓语。Young as he is=Though he is young。as表'虽然'，前置表语/状语形成倒装。注意名词前置时省冠词：Child as he is。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：as引导让步倒装（表语+as+主语+谓语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 虽然他年轻，但他懂得很多。

questions.question: Analyze the clause type: 'The fact that he passed the exam surprised everyone.' What type of clause is 'that he passed the exam'?
questions.questionCn: 分析从句类型：'The fact that he passed the exam surprised everyone.'中that he passed the exam是什么从句？
questions.answer: It is an appositive clause (同位语从句).
questions.explanation: that he passed the exam是同位语从句，解释the fact的内容（他通过考试这个事实）。判断同位语从句vs定语从句：同位语从句that不作成分且从句完整；定语从句that作成分。本句he passed the exam完整，that不作成分→同位语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：同位语从句判断（that不作成分，从句完整）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他通过考试这个事实让所有人惊讶。

questions.question: Fill in the blank with a substitute word: — Will he come? — I hope ___.
questions.questionCn: 用替代词填空：—他会来吗？—我希望如此。
questions.explanation: hope so中so替代上文he will come，避免重复。so替代肯定句，not替代否定句。I hope so=我希望如此。替代词so/not用于believe/think/hope/suppose等后：I think so, I hope not。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：so替代肯定句（hope so=希望如此）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他会来吗？——我希望如此。

questions.passage: It is widely acknowledged that the policy which was introduced last year has brought significant changes to the industry. What surprised many experts was that the effects appeared much faster than anyone had expected. The government, which had been criticized for its slow response, finally admitted that more measures were needed. There is no doubt that the reform will continue, though how it will be implemented remains uncertain.
questions.passageCn: 人们普遍认为，去年出台的政策给该行业带来了重大变化。令许多专家惊讶的是，效果出现的速度比任何人预期的都要快。一直因反应迟缓而受到批评的政府，最终承认需要采取更多措施。毫无疑问，改革将会继续，但如何实施仍然不确定。

subQuestions.question: What type of clause is 'that the policy which was introduced last year has brought significant changes to the industry'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'that the policy...'是什么类型的从句？
subQuestions.explanation: It是形式主语，that从句是真正的主语从句。It is widely acknowledged that...中that引导主语从句。从句成分完整（the policy has brought changes），that只起连接作用。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：It is...that主语从句（形式主语+真正主语）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 人们普遍认为，去年出台的政策给该行业带来了重大变化。

subQuestions.question: True or False: In 'What surprised many experts was that the effects appeared much faster', 'What surprised many experts' is a subject clause.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：在'What surprised many experts was that...'中，'What surprised many experts'是主语从句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。What surprised many experts是主语从句，what在其中作surprised的宾语。was后接that引导的表语从句。what引导名词性从句时必须在从句中作成分。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：what引导主语从句（what作宾语）+ that引导表语从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 令许多专家惊讶的是，效果出现的速度比任何人预期的都要快。

questions.passage: Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to inform you that our company has decided to invest in the new project. We are very interested in cooperating with your team. As for the budget, we need to look into the details before making a final decision. Please let us know if you are available for a meeting next week. We look forward to hearing from you soon. Yours sincerely, John Lee.
questions.passageCn: 亲爱的史密斯先生，我写信通知您，我们公司已决定投资新项目。我们对与您的团队合作非常感兴趣。至于预算，我们需要在做出最终决定前调查细节。请告诉我们您下周是否有空开会。期待很快收到您的回复。您真诚的，李约翰。

subQuestions.question: Which preposition correctly fills the blank in 'We are very interested ___ cooperating with your team'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 填入正确介词：'We are very interested ___ cooperating'。
subQuestions.explanation: be interested in=对...感兴趣，in是固定介词。形容词+介词搭配：interested in, good at, afraid of, proud of。in后接动名词cooperating。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be interested in + doing（形容词+介词）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 我们对与您的团队合作非常感兴趣。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'look forward to hearing from you' uses 'to' as an infinitive marker.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'look forward to hearing'中的to是不定式符号。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。look forward to中to是介词，后接动名词doing（hearing），不是不定式符号。介词to的搭配还有：be used to, devote...to..., object to, pay attention to等。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：look forward to中to是介词，后接doing
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 期待很快收到您的回复。

questions.passage: The phenomenon that a growing number of young people choose to work from home, which has been made possible by the rapid development of technology, has raised a heated debate among sociologists. Some argue that working remotely improves productivity, while others believe that it leads to social isolation. The truth, as many experts have pointed out, lies somewhere in between.
questions.passageCn: 越来越多的年轻人选择在家办公这一现象——这得益于技术的快速发展——在社会学家中引发了激烈的争论。一些人认为远程办公提高了生产力，而另一些人则认为这会导致社交孤立。正如许多专家所指出的，真相介于两者之间。

subQuestions.question: What is the main clause (subject + predicate) of the first sentence?
subQuestions.questionCn: 第一句的主句（主语+谓语）是什么？
choices: A. A growing number of young people choose to work from home
B. Which has been made possible by the rapid development of technology
C. The phenomenon has raised a heated debate
subQuestions.explanation: 主干是The phenomenon has raised a heated debate。that从句是同位语从句解释phenomenon的内容；which从句是非限制性定语从句（插入语）修饰前面整个that从句。长难句分析：先找主干，剥离同位语从句和插入的定语从句。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：识别主干（同位语从句+非限制性定语从句嵌套）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 这一现象在社会学家中引发了激烈的争论。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'as many experts have pointed out' is a non-restrictive relative clause inserted as a parenthesis.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'as many experts have pointed out'是非限制性定语从句，作插入语。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。as引导非限制性定语从句，指代整个主句内容，作插入语。as=正如。逗号间的插入语不影响主干结构。as引导非限制性定语从句可放句首、句中或句末。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：as引导非限制性定语从句作插入语
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 正如许多专家所指出的，真相介于两者之间。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The fact ___ he failed the exam disappointed his parents.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：他考试不及格的事实让父母很失望。
questions.explanation: 此为同位语从句。The fact后接that引导的从句，解释fact的具体内容。that在同位语从句中只起连接作用，不作成分，无词义。同位语从句常跟在fact, news, idea, hope, suggestion等抽象名词后，解释该名词的内容。区别定语从句与同位语从句：定语从句中that作成分（主语/宾语），同位语从句中that不作成分。此句that从句结构完整，不作成分，是同位语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：that引导同位语从句解释fact的内容
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他考试不及格的事实让父母很失望。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ from the top of the mountain, the city looks like a small village.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：从山顶看下去，这座城市看起来像一个小村庄。
questions.explanation: 分词作状语，逻辑主语是主句主语the city。the city与see是被动关系（城市被看），用过去分词Seen。= When the city is seen from the top of the mountain, it looks like a small village. 分词状语判断：①找逻辑主语（主句主语）；②判断主被动关系；③主动用doing，被动用done。Seeing表主动（从山顶看城市），Seen表被动（城市被看）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：过去分词Seen作状语表被动
questions.sentenceTranslation: 从山顶看下去，这座城市看起来像一个小村庄。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It is high time that we ___ action to protect the environment.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：是我们采取行动保护环境的时候了。
questions.explanation: It is (high/about) time that...句型用虚拟语气，从句谓语用过去式。It is high time that we took action=是我们采取行动的时候了。此结构固定用过去式表示'该做某事了'（实际上还没做）。类似虚拟结构：It is time that+主语+过去式/should+动词原形（should较少用）。took是take的过去式。这是英语特有的虚拟语气结构，需整体记忆。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气进阶：It is high time that+过去式
questions.sentenceTranslation: 是我们采取行动保护环境的时候了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Not only ___ the exam, but he also got the highest score.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：他不仅通过了考试，还得了最高分。
questions.explanation: Not only置于句首时，前半句部分倒装。部分倒装：Not only+助动词+主语+动词原形。原句：He not only passed the exam but also got the highest score. 把Not only提前后倒装为did he pass。Not only...but also...（不仅...而且...）中Not only在句首时倒装，but also后不倒装。倒装触发词：Not only, Never, Seldom, Hardly, Not until等。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句综合：Not only句首→部分倒装did he pass
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅通过了考试，还得了最高分。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is very good ___ math but weak ___ English.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确介词：她数学很好但英语很差。
questions.explanation: be good at=擅长（在某方面好），be weak in=在...方面弱。但注意：be good at和be weak in后都接学科/领域时用法灵活，此题good at math和weak in English。实际上be weak in和be poor in用法相同。固定搭配中at/in的选择需逐个记忆。常见搭配：good at擅长，interested in对...感兴趣，afraid of害怕，proud of以...为豪，famous for因...出名。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be good at + 学科（擅长某方面）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她数学很好但英语很差。

questions.question: Choose the correct analysis: The boy sitting under the tree, who is wearing a red shirt, is my cousin.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确分析：坐在树下、穿着红色衬衫的那个男孩是我表弟。
choices: A. sitting under the tree是宾语
B. who is wearing a red shirt是定语从句
questions.explanation: 句子主干：The boy is my cousin.（男孩是我表弟。）sitting under the tree是现在分词作后置定语修饰The boy。who is wearing a red shirt是非限制性定语从句，补充修饰The boy。is my cousin是主句谓语+表语。长难句分析步骤：①找主干（主语+谓语）；②分析修饰成分（定语/状语/从句）；③理解句意。主干The boy is my cousin清晰后，其余为修饰。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：主干The boy is my cousin + 分词定语+非限制性定语从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 坐在树下、穿着红色衬衫的那个男孩是我表弟。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The novel ___ into more than thirty languages so far.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：到目前为止，这部小说已被翻译成三十多种语言。
questions.explanation: so far（到目前为止）是现在完成时标志。主语The novel是translate的承受者（小说被翻译），用被动。现在完成时被动：has/have been+过去分词。novel是单数，用has been translated。时态判断：so far→现在完成时；语态判断：小说被翻译→被动。两者结合：has been translated。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态综合：so far→现在完成时被动has been translated
questions.sentenceTranslation: 到目前为止，这部小说已被翻译成三十多种语言。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It was not until midnight ___ he finished his work.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：直到午夜他才完成工作。
questions.explanation: 这是强调句型It is/was...that...。强调not until midnight部分。强调句结构：It is/was+被强调部分+that+其余部分。原句：He did not finish his work until midnight. 强调until midnight：It was not until midnight that he finished his work. 强调句的判断方法：去掉It is/was和that后，句子仍然结构完整。that在此只起连接作用。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It was...that强调not until部分
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到午夜他才完成工作。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The reason why he was late was because he missed the bus.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：他迟到的原因是他错过了公交车。
questions.explanation: 错误。The reason...was because...是常见错误搭配。正确：The reason why he was late was that he missed the bus. reason和because不能同时使用，因为because本身就有'因为...的原因'之意。用that引导表语从句解释reason的内容。固定搭配：The reason why...is that...（...的原因是...）。这是英语中需要注意的思维差异，要避免语义重复。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：The reason why...is that（不能用because）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他迟到的原因是他错过了公交车。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：做完作业后，他出去玩了。
questions.explanation: 正确。Having finished是现在分词的完成式，表示分词动作在主句动词之前完成。Having finished his homework=做完作业后（先完成作业，再出去玩）。现在分词完成式：Having+过去分词，表先于主句动作完成。= After he had finished his homework, he went out to play. 分词完成式作时间状语，逻辑主语he与主句主语一致。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：Having finished完成式表先于主句动作
questions.sentenceTranslation: 做完作业后，他出去玩了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: I would rather you didn't smoke here.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我宁愿你别在这里抽烟。
questions.explanation: 正确。would rather后接从句时用虚拟语气。表示对现在/将来的愿望，从句用过去式。would rather+主语+过去式=宁愿某人（不）做某事。didn't smoke是过去式否定形式，表示'现在别抽'。would rather用法：①would rather do sth（宁愿自己做）；②would rather+主语+过去式（宁愿别人做，虚拟语气）。这是英语特有的虚拟语气结构，需整体记忆。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气进阶：would rather+从句用过去式
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我宁愿你别在这里抽烟。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Seldom I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我很少见到这么美的日落。
questions.explanation: 错误。Seldom（很少）是否定词，置于句首时主句需部分倒装。正确：Seldom have I seen such a beautiful sunset. 部分倒装：否定词+助动词+主语+动词原形。原句：I have seldom seen...，把Seldom提前后倒装为have I seen。否定/半否定词倒装触发：Never, Seldom, Rarely, Hardly, Scarcely, Little, Not only等。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句综合：Seldom句首→部分倒装have I seen
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我很少见到这么美的日落。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is addicted ___ playing video games and his parents are worried about him.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他沉迷于打电子游戏，他的父母很担心他。
questions.explanation: be addicted to=沉迷于，to是介词，后接动名词playing。注意此处的to是介词（不是不定式符号），后接名词或动名词。容易混淆的to搭配：be used to doing（习惯于做），look forward to doing（期待做），devote...to doing（致力于做），object to doing（反对做）。这些to都是介词，后接doing。区分：want to do（to do不定式），be addicted to doing（to doing介词）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be addicted to + doing（to是介词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他沉迷于打电子游戏，他的父母很担心他。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The professor, together with his students, ___ (be) going to attend the conference.
questions.questionCn: 填空：教授和他的学生们将一起参加学术会议。
questions.explanation: 主语是The professor（单数），together with his students是伴随状语，不影响主语的单复数。谓语动词与真正的主语The professor保持一致，用is。就远原则：主语后跟with, together with, along with, as well as, besides等时，谓语动词与前面的主语一致。= The professor is going to attend...（his students不影响动词）。英语主谓一致有明确的规则，就远原则是其中之一。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：就远原则，together with不影响主谓一致
questions.sentenceTranslation: 教授和他的学生们将一起参加学术会议。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The bridge ___ (build) when the earthquake happened.
questions.questionCn: 填空：地震发生时，这座桥正在建设中。
questions.explanation: when the earthquake happened（地震发生时）是过去时间点，此时桥正在被建，用过去进行时的被动语态。过去进行时被动：was/were+being+过去分词。bridge是单数，用was being built。被动语态各时态总结：一般现在时is done，一般过去时was done，现在进行时is being done，过去进行时was being done，现在完成时has been done。英语被动语态结构规律，各时态都通过be动词的变化来体现。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态综合：过去进行时被动was being built
questions.sentenceTranslation: 地震发生时，这座桥正在建设中。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It is you who ___ (be) responsible for this project.
questions.questionCn: 填空：是你对这个项目负责。
questions.explanation: 这是强调句型It is...who...。强调主语you，从句谓语与被强调的主语you保持一致，用are。强调句中that/who后的动词与被强调部分一致：It is I who am...（强调I用am），It is you who are...（强调you用are），It is he who is...（强调he用is）。强调句结构：It is/was+被强调部分+that/who+其余。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It is...who...，动词与被强调部分一致
questions.sentenceTranslation: 是你对这个项目负责。

questions.question: Rewrite using the subjunctive mood: He talks too much in class. (Use 'It is suggested that')
questions.questionCn: 用虚拟语气改写：他上课话太多。（使用It is suggested that）
questions.answer: It is suggested that he (should) not talk too much in class.
questions.explanation: It is suggested that...句型中，that从句用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。should可省略，但动词必须用原形。suggest表'建议'时，其后的主语从句用虚拟语气。原意'他话太多'改为建议'他不该说太多'，用should not talk或直接not talk。类似结构：It is demanded/requested/required/ordered that+主语+(should)+动词原形。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气进阶：It is suggested that+(should)+动词原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 建议他上课不要说太多话。

questions.question: Combine using an infinitive: He has a lot of work. He must finish it. (Use '...work to finish')
questions.questionCn: 用不定式合并句子：他有很多工作。他必须完成它。（使用'...work to finish'）
questions.answer: He has a lot of work to finish.
questions.explanation: 不定式to finish作后置定语修饰work，表'要完成的工作'。不定式作定语常表将来：work to finish（要完成的工作），letters to write（要写的信），decisions to make（要做的决定）。不定式作定语放在名词后。= He has a lot of work that he must finish. 不定式使句子更简洁。被动形式：work to be finished（待完成的工作）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：不定式to finish作后置定语表将来
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他有很多要完成的工作。

questions.passage: Our campus life is colorful and meaningful. What I like most is the reading club, where students can share their favorite books. The club, which was started by a group of literature lovers, has more than two hundred members now. It is generally believed that reading can broaden our horizons. That is why so many students join the club. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced reader, you will find something interesting here.
questions.passageCn: 我们的校园生活丰富多彩且有意义。我最喜欢的是读书俱乐部，在那里学生们可以分享他们最喜欢的书。这个俱乐部由一群文学爱好者创办，现在有两百多名成员。人们普遍认为阅读能开阔我们的视野。这就是为什么这么多学生加入俱乐部的原因。无论你是初学者还是高级读者，你都会在这里发现有趣的东西。

subQuestions.question: What type of clause is 'What I like most'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'What I like most'是什么类型的从句？
subQuestions.explanation: What I like most是主语从句，作整个句子的主语。is是谓语，the reading club是表语。what在从句中作like的宾语。主语从句分析：what引导，在从句中作成分（宾语），整个从句作主语。= The thing that I like most is the reading club.
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：what引导主语从句（what作宾语）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 我最喜欢的是读书俱乐部。

subQuestions.question: True or False: In 'That is why so many students join the club', 'why' introduces a predicative clause.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：在'That is why...'中，why引导表语从句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。That是主语，is是系动词，why so many students join the club是表语从句。why引导表语从句，解释That（上文提到的原因）的具体内容。why在表语从句中作原因状语。表语从句结构：主语+be+从句（that/why/because/what等引导）。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：why引导表语从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 这就是为什么这么多学生加入俱乐部的原因。

questions.passage: Last weekend, our family gathered for a big dinner. My mother was in charge of the cooking. She is good at making dumplings. My father helped with the table setting. My grandmother told us stories about her childhood. We were proud of our family tradition. After dinner, we looked forward to watching a movie together. Everyone was satisfied with the delicious food and happy atmosphere.
questions.passageCn: 上周末，我们全家聚在一起吃大餐。妈妈负责做饭。她擅长包饺子。爸爸帮忙摆餐具。奶奶给我们讲了她童年的故事。我们为家庭传统感到自豪。晚饭后，我们期待一起看电影。每个人对美味的食物和欢乐的氛围都感到满意。

subQuestions.question: Which phrase means '擅长' in the passage?
subQuestions.questionCn: 短文中哪个短语表示'擅长'？
subQuestions.explanation: good at=擅长，后接动名词making。固定搭配辨析：in charge of=负责，good at=擅长，proud of=以...为豪，satisfied with=对...满意。每个搭配后接的介词不同：at, of, with。介词搭配需逐个记忆。be good at doing（擅长做），be proud of sth（以...为豪）。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be good at + doing（擅长）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 她擅长包饺子。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'looked forward to watching' is correct because 'to' is a preposition.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'looked forward to watching'正确，因为to是介词。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。look forward to中to是介词，后接动名词watching（不是watch）。look forward to doing=期待做某事。to有两种用法：①不定式符号to+动词原形（want to go）；②介词to+名词/动名词（look forward to going）。此处to是介词。类似：be used to doing, object to doing, devote to doing。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：look forward to + doing（to是介词）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 晚饭后，我们期待一起看电影。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The fact ___ she survived the accident is a miracle.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：她在事故中幸存下来这个事实是个奇迹。
questions.explanation: 同位语从句，that解释fact的内容（她幸存了），that只起连接作用不作成分且不可省。同位语从句vs定语从句：同位语从句that不作成分不可省；定语从句that作主/宾语可省。that解释名词内容=同位语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：同位语从句that解释名词内容（不作成分不可省）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她在事故中幸存下来这个事实是个奇迹。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: With the problem ___, we felt relieved.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：问题解决了，我们松了口气。
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构With+n.+过去分词，problem与solve是被动关系（问题被解决），用过去分词solved。With+n.+done表被动/已完成；With+n.+doing表主动/正在进行；With+n.+to do表将来。问题已解决（被动+完成）→solved。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：独立主格With+n.+done表被动完成
questions.sentenceTranslation: 问题解决了，我们松了口气。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It is high time we ___ home.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我们该回家了。
questions.explanation: It is (high/about) time that+从句用虚拟语气，动词用过去式。It is high time we went home=我们该回家了。固定结构It is time+主语+过去式，表'该做某事了'。用过去式表虚拟（实际上还没做），暗示应立即行动。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：It is (high) time + 从句用过去式
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们该回家了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Only by working hard ___ your goals.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：只有努力工作你才能实现目标。
questions.explanation: Only+状语（by working hard）放句首时，主句部分倒装（情态动词can提前）。结构：Only+状语+助/情/be+主语+动词原形。can you achieve=你能实现。部分倒装=助动词/情态动词/be动词提前。Only表'只有...才'。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：Only+状语放句首，部分倒装can+主语+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 只有努力工作你才能实现目标。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is very good ___ math but weak ___ English.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确介词：她数学很好但英语不好。
questions.explanation: be good at=擅长，be weak in/at=不擅长。两处都用at。good at+doing=擅长做某事。at是固定介词搭配。注意：be good at=擅长，be bad/poor at=不擅长，后都接at。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be good at / be weak at（介词at）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她数学很好但英语不好。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The professor, along with his assistants, ___ working on a new project.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：教授和他的助手们正在做一个新项目。
questions.explanation: 主语是The professor（单数），along with his assistants是插入语，不影响主谓一致，be动词用is。along with/together with/with/as well as等插入语不影响主语单复数。主语是professor（单数），用is。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句：along with插入语不影响主谓一致
questions.sentenceTranslation: 教授和他的助手们正在做一个新项目。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The project ___ by the end of next month.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：项目将在下月底前完成。
questions.explanation: by the end of next month是将来的时间点，主句用将来完成时被动：will have been+过去分词。project与complete是被动关系（项目被完成）。将来完成时被动=will have been+过去分词，表将来某时间前完成。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态：将来完成时被动will have been+done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 项目将在下月底前完成。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It was in 2003 ___ he graduated from college.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：正是在2003年他从大学毕业的。
questions.explanation: 强调句结构：It is/was+被强调部分+that+其他。强调in 2003（时间状语），用that。判断强调句：去掉It is/was和that后句子仍完整（He graduated from college in 2003）。强调句中that不变who/which/when，一律用that。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It is/was...that...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 正是在2003年他从大学毕业的。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ surprised us most was that he passed the exam.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：最让我们惊讶的是他通过了考试。
questions.explanation: 主语从句缺主语（什么让我们惊讶），用what引导。what=the thing that，在从句中作surprised的主语。that在从句中不作成分，从句缺主语时不能用that。What surprised us=让我们惊讶的事。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：主语从句缺主语用what
questions.sentenceTranslation: 最让我们惊讶的是他通过了考试。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ from the top of the hill, the city looks beautiful.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：从山顶看下去，城市很美。
questions.explanation: 分词状语，主语the city与see是被动关系（城市被看），用过去分词Seen。Seen from the top=When the city is seen from the top。过去分词表被动。主语是city（被看）不是人（看），所以用seen不用seeing。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：过去分词作状语表被动（城市被看）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 从山顶看下去，城市很美。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: So fast ___ that we could hardly catch up with him.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：他跑得太快了，我们几乎追不上他。
questions.explanation: So+副词/形容词放句首时，主句部分倒装（助动词did提前）。结构：So+adv/adj+助/情/be+主语+动词。did he run=他跑。一般过去时用did提前，动词恢复原形run。So...that=如此...以至于。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：So+adv放句首，部分倒装did+主语+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他跑得太快了，我们几乎追不上他。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: She is looking forward to ___ from you soon.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：她期待很快收到你的来信。
questions.explanation: look forward to中to是介词，后接动名词hearing。look forward to+doing sth=期待做某事。hear from sb=收到某人来信。to是介词不是不定式符号，后接名词/动名词。类似：be used to, pay attention to, object to后都接doing。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：look forward to + doing（to是介词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她期待很快收到你的来信。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The news which our team won the game excited everyone.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我们队赢了比赛的消息让所有人兴奋。
questions.explanation: 错误。解释news内容的同位语从句用that不用which。正确：The news that our team won the game excited everyone. that在同位语从句中不作成分不可省，which在从句中须作主/宾语。同位语从句用that，不用which。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：同位语从句用that不用which
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们队赢了比赛的消息让所有人兴奋。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The boy was seen enter the building at 9 PM.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：有人看见那个男孩晚上9点进入了大楼。
questions.explanation: 错误。感官动词see的被动语态后接不定式to do。正确：The boy was seen to enter the building at 9 PM. 主动语态see sb do sth中省to，但被动语态be seen to do要还原to。see sb do→sb be seen to do。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：感官动词被动语态还原to（be seen to do）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 有人看见那个男孩晚上9点进入了大楼。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The teacher suggested that the student studies harder.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：老师建议那个学生更努力学习。
questions.explanation: 错误。suggest后的宾语从句用虚拟语气should+动词原形，should可省。正确：The teacher suggested that the student (should) study harder. suggest/recommend/demand/insist等后的从句用(should)+动词原形。study用原形不加s。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：suggest后从句用(should)+动词原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 老师建议那个学生更努力学习。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Not only he is a good student, but also a talented musician.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：他不仅是个好学生，还是个有天赋的音乐家。
questions.explanation: 错误。Not only放句首时部分倒装（be动词is提前）。正确：Not only is he a good student, but also a talented musician. Not only+助/情/be+主语。is提前→is he。Not only...but also=不仅...而且。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：Not only放句首，部分倒装is+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅是个好学生，还是个有天赋的音乐家。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The car has been repairing by the mechanic for two hours.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：这辆车已经被机修工修了两个小时了。
questions.explanation: 错误。车是被修的，应用现在完成时被动has been repaired，而不是现在分词repairing。正确：The car has been repaired by the mechanic for two hours. 现在完成时被动=have/has been+过去分词。be+done=被动。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态：现在完成时被动has been+过去分词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这辆车已经被机修工修了两个小时了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: It was not until he told me that I knew the truth.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：直到他告诉我，我才知道真相。
questions.explanation: 正确。It was not until...that...=直到...才...，强调句结构。强调not until部分。去掉It was和that后仍完整：Not until he told me did I know the truth（倒装）。not until=直到...才，强调时用It is/was not until...that...
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It was not until...that...（直到...才）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到他告诉我，我才知道真相。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The question ___ we should accept the offer needs discussion.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们是否应该接受这个提议需要讨论。
questions.explanation: 同位语从句解释question的内容，表'是否'用whether。whether可接or not，that不表'是否'。whether...or not=是否。that在同位语从句中不作成分不表'是否'。whether引导同位语从句表选择。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：同位语从句表'是否'用whether
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们是否应该接受这个提议需要讨论。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (not know) the answer, he remained silent.
questions.questionCn: 填空：因为不知道答案，他保持沉默。
questions.explanation: 现在分词作原因状语，主语he与know是主动关系（他知道/不知道），用现在分词knowing。否定形式在分词前加Not：Not knowing=Because he didn't know。现在分词表主动/与主句同时。主语he主动不知道→Not knowing。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：现在分词否定Not doing作原因状语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 因为不知道答案，他保持沉默。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I would rather you ___ (not tell) him the truth.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我宁愿你没告诉他真相。
questions.explanation: would rather+从句用虚拟语气，与现在/将来相反用过去时，与过去相反用过去完成时。此处tell是现在/将来语境（没告诉他），用过去时didn't tell。would rather sb did sth=宁愿某人做某事。用过去式表虚拟。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：would rather+从句用过去时
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我宁愿你没告诉他真相。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Rarely ___ (we see) such a beautiful sunset.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们很少看到如此美丽的日落。
questions.explanation: 否定副词Rarely放句首时部分倒装（助动词do提前）。结构：Rarely+助/情/be+主语+动词原形。一般现在时用do提前，we see→do we see。Rarely=很少=seldom，否定词放句首引起倒装。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：否定副词Rarely放句首，部分倒装do+主语+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们很少看到如此美丽的日落。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She paid no attention ___ the warnings and continued driving.
questions.questionCn: 填空：她没理会警告，继续开车。
questions.explanation: pay attention to sth=注意某事，固定搭配，to是介词。pay no attention to=不理会。to后接名词warnings。pay attention to中to是介词不是不定式。固定介词搭配需整体记忆。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：pay attention to（介词to）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她没理会警告，继续开车。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It was Tom ___ broke the window yesterday.
questions.questionCn: 填空：昨天是汤姆打破了窗户。
questions.explanation: 强调句It was+被强调人+who/that+其他。强调Tom（人），用who或that。It was Tom who broke the window=Tom broke the window（强调Tom）。强调人用who/that，强调物用that。去掉It was和who/that后句子仍完整。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It was+人+who/that
questions.sentenceTranslation: 昨天是汤姆打破了窗户。

questions.question: Combine into one sentence using an appositive clause: The news is exciting. Our team won the championship.
questions.questionCn: 用同位语从句合并：我们的队赢得了冠军，这个消息很令人兴奋。
questions.answer: The news that our team won the championship is exciting.
questions.explanation: 用that引导同位语从句解释news的内容。that只起连接作用不作成分不可省。结构：名词+that+从句（解释名词内容）。同位语从句vs定语从句：同位语从句that不作成分不可省；定语从句that作成分可省。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：同位语从句that解释news内容
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们的队赢得了冠军，这个消息很令人兴奋。

questions.question: Rewrite using an absolute structure: As the weather was fine, we went for a picnic.
questions.questionCn: 用独立主格改写：天气很好，我们去野餐了。
questions.answer: The weather being fine, we went for a picnic.
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构：名词+分词（自带主语，与主句主语不同）。The weather being fine=As the weather was fine。weather与主句主语we不同，需自带主语。being fine=现在分词表主动/同时。独立主格=自带主语的分词状语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：独立主格名词+doing（自带主语的分词状语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 天气很好，我们去野餐了。

questions.question: Rewrite using inversion with 'No sooner': As soon as he arrived, the meeting began.
questions.questionCn: 用No sooner倒装改写：他一到，会议就开始了。
questions.answer: No sooner had he arrived than the meeting began.
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...=一...就...，No sooner放句首时部分倒装（had提前）。结构：No sooner+had+主语+过去分词+than+从句。had he arrived=他到了。No sooner放句首倒装。had arrived=过去完成时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：No sooner+had+主语+过去分词+than
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他一到，会议就开始了。

questions.passage: The new museum, which was completed last year, has attracted thousands of visitors. It was designed by a famous architect who has won many awards. The building is being renovated now because some problems were found in the roof. When the renovation is finished, an opening ceremony will be held. It is expected that the museum will have been visited by over a million people by the end of this year.
questions.passageCn: 去年完工的新博物馆已经吸引了成千上万的游客。它由一位获得过许多奖项的著名建筑师设计。由于屋顶发现了一些问题，这座建筑目前正在修缮。修缮完成后将举行开幕式。预计到今年年底，参观博物馆的人数将超过一百万。

subQuestions.question: What is happening to the building now?
subQuestions.questionCn: 现在建筑正在发生什么？
subQuestions.explanation: 原文：'The building is being renovated now.'。is being renovated是现在进行时被动语态（is being+过去分词），表示此刻正在被修缮。现在进行时被动=be being+done。主语building与renovate是被动关系。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态：现在进行时被动is being+过去分词
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 这座建筑目前正在修缮。

subQuestions.question: True or False: The museum was designed by an unknown architect.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：博物馆由一位不知名的建筑师设计。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。原文说'a famous architect who has won many awards'（一位获得过许多奖项的著名建筑师），不是不知名的。was designed是一般过去时被动。has won是现在完成时。famous=著名的。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态：一般过去时被动was designed + 现在完成时has won
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 它由一位著名的建筑师设计。

subQuestions.question: What is expected by the end of this year?
subQuestions.questionCn: 到今年年底预计会怎样？
choices: C. A new building will be built
subQuestions.explanation: 原文：'the museum will have been visited by over a million people by the end of this year.'。will have been visited是将来完成时被动（will have been+过去分词），表将来某时间前被动完成的动作。by the end of this year=到今年底。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态：将来完成时被动will have been+过去分词
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 到今年年底，参观人数将超过一百万。

questions.passage: The reason why he failed the exam was that he had not prepared well. What surprised everyone was that he had always been a top student before. The teacher said that it was because he had spent too much time playing games. His parents, who were very worried, decided to have a talk with him. They hoped that he would realize the importance of studying and that he would catch up with his classmates soon.
questions.passageCn: 他考试不及格的原因是他没有好好准备。让大家惊讶的是他以前一直是优等生。老师说这是因为他花了太多时间玩游戏。他的父母非常担心，决定和他谈一谈。他们希望他能认识到学习的重要性，尽快赶上同学们。

subQuestions.question: Why did he fail the exam?
subQuestions.questionCn: 他为什么考试不及格？
choices: B. Because he had not prepared well
C. Because the exam was too hard
subQuestions.explanation: 原文：'The reason why he failed the exam was that he had not prepared well.'。why引导定语从句修饰reason。that引导表语从句解释reason的内容。had not prepared是过去完成时（先于failed），表在考试前就没有好好准备。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：why定语从句+that表语从句+过去完成时
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 他考试不及格的原因是他没有好好准备。

subQuestions.question: True or False: He had always been a poor student before.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：他以前一直是个差生。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。原文说'he had always been a top student before'（以前一直是优等生），不是差生。had been是过去完成时（先于现在之前的状态）。top student=优等生，poor student=差生，意思相反。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：宾语从句+过去完成时had been + 细节理解
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 让大家惊讶的是他以前一直是优等生。

subQuestions.question: What did his parents hope?
subQuestions.questionCn: 他的父母希望什么？
choices: A. That he would drop out of school
B. That he would realize the importance of studying
C. That he would change schools
D. That he would become a gamer
subQuestions.explanation: 原文：'They hoped that he would realize the importance of studying.'。that引导宾语从句，would realize是过去将来时（从过去看将来）。would+动词原形=过去将来时。importance of studying=学习的重要性。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：宾语从句that+过去将来时would+原形
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 他们希望他能认识到学习的重要性。

questions.passage: It was not until he received the letter that he knew the truth. It was the letter that changed his life. Never before had he been so shocked. Not only did he read it again and again, but he also shared it with his best friend. Only after careful consideration did he decide to take action. So moved was he that he could not sleep that night. It was this experience that made him a stronger person.
questions.passageCn: 直到收到那封信他才知道真相。正是那封信改变了他的一生。他以前从未如此震惊过。他不仅反复阅读，还分享给了最好的朋友。只有经过深思熟虑他才决定采取行动。他感动得那晚都睡不着。正是这段经历让他成了一个更坚强的人。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'It was not until he received the letter that he knew the truth'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'It was not until he received the letter that he knew the truth'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: It was not until...that...是强调句（分裂句），强调not until部分。结构：It is/was+被强调部分+that+其他。强调'直到收到信'这个时间状语。去掉It was和that后仍完整：Not until he received the letter did he know the truth（倒装形式）。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It was not until...that...
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 直到收到那封信他才知道真相。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Never before had he been so shocked' uses normal word order.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Never before had he been so shocked'使用了正常语序。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。Never before放句首时部分倒装（had提前）。正常语序是He had never been so shocked before。否定词Never放句首→部分倒装had+主语+been。部分倒装=助动词/情态动词/be动词提前。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：否定词Never放句首引起部分倒装had+主语
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 他以前从未如此震惊过。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'So moved was he that he could not sleep'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'So moved was he that he could not sleep'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: So+形容词放句首时部分倒装（be动词was提前）。结构：So+adj/adv+be/助/情+主语+that+从句。So moved was he=He was so moved that...。So...that=如此...以至于，So放句首倒装。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：So+adj放句首引起倒装+that从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 他感动得那晚都睡不着。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The question ___ we should accept the offer needs careful consideration.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：我们是否应该接受这个提议的问题需要仔细考虑。
questions.explanation: whether引导同位语从句，解释question的内容（我们是否应该接受提议）。whether...or not引导同位语从句表'是否'。that引导同位语从句时不表'是否'，what和which不能引导同位语从句。whether可引导同位语从句，if不能。同位语从句解释名词内容。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：whether引导同位语从句表'是否'
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们是否应该接受这个提议的问题需要仔细考虑。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ from the top of the mountain, the city looks like a small village.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：从山顶看去，这座城市看起来像一个小村庄。
questions.explanation: 过去分词seen作状语，表被动。the city和see是被动关系（城市被看），用过去分词。从山顶看（城市被看），用Seen。现在分词表主动，过去分词表被动。分词作状语，逻辑主语与主句主语一致。Seen from the mountain=When the city is seen from the mountain。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：过去分词seen作状语表被动
questions.sentenceTranslation: 从山顶看去，这座城市看起来像一个小村庄。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It is high time that we ___ action to protect the environment.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我们早该采取行动保护环境了。
questions.explanation: It is high time that...后用虚拟语气，动词用过去时（took）。It is (high) time that+主语+过去时，表示'是时候该做某事了'。固定虚拟结构，强调该做但还没做的事。took是虚拟语气形式，不是真正的过去时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟进阶：It is high time that+主语+过去时（该做某事了）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们早该采取行动保护环境了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Only when you lose something ___ its true value.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：只有当你失去某样东西时，你才会认识到它真正的价值。
questions.explanation: Only+状语从句放句首时，主句部分倒装。助动词do提前到主语you之前。正常语序：You realize its true value only when you lose something。Only放句首引起部分倒装，倒装的是主句不是从句。部分倒装=助动词/情态动词提前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：Only+状语从句放句首，主句部分倒装do+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 只有当你失去某样东西时，你才会认识到它真正的价值。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is very good ___ dealing with difficult customers.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确介词：她非常擅长应付难缠的顾客。
questions.explanation: be good at+doing sth=擅长做某事，固定搭配，at是介词后接动名词。be good at=擅长，be good for=对...有益，be good with=善于和...打交道。deal with=处理。介词搭配需记忆，不同介词意思不同。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be good at+doing（擅长做某事）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她非常擅长应付难缠的顾客。

questions.question: Choose the correct analysis: 'The fact that he passed the exam surprised everyone' contains:
questions.questionCn: 选择正确分析：'The fact that he passed the exam surprised everyone'包含：
questions.explanation: that引导同位语从句，解释fact的内容（他通过了考试）。同位语从句vs定语从句：同位语从句的that不作成分且不可省，定语从句的that作主/宾语可省。The fact that...=...的事实。同位语从句与先行词是等同关系，定语从句是修饰关系。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：that引导同位语从句（解释名词内容）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他通过考试的事实让所有人惊讶。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The report ___ by the time the manager comes back.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：等经理回来时，报告就已经完成了。
questions.explanation: by the time+一般现在时（comes back），主句用将来完成时。report是finish的承受者（报告被完成），用被动语态。将来完成时被动：will have been+过去分词。by+将来时间用将来完成时，被动语态加been。report是被完成的，所以用被动。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态综合：将来完成时被动will have been+done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 等经理回来时，报告就已经完成了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It was not until midnight ___ he finished his homework.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：直到午夜他才完成作业。
questions.explanation: It was not until...that...是强调句，强调not until midnight（直到午夜）。结构：It is/was+被强调部分+that+其他。强调not until时间状语。去掉It was和that后：Not until midnight did he finish his homework（倒装形式）。强调句的that不可用when/which替换。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It was not until...that...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到午夜他才完成作业。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The news which our team won the game made us excited.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我们队赢了比赛的消息让我们很兴奋。
