questions.explanation: 错误。news后是同位语从句（解释news的内容），应用that不用which。正确：The news that our team won the game made us excited. 同位语从句用that不用which，that只起连接作用不作成分。which引导定语从句作主语或宾语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：同位语从句用that不用which
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们队赢了比赛的消息让我们很兴奋。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Weather permitted, we will go camping tomorrow.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：天气允许的话，我们明天去露营。
questions.explanation: 错误。weather和permit是主动关系（天气允许），应用现在分词permitting，构成独立主格结构。正确：Weather permitting, we will go camping tomorrow. 独立主格：名词+分词，名词是分词的逻辑主语。主动用现在分词，被动用过去分词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语进阶：独立主格Weather permitting（主动用现在分词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 天气允许的话，我们明天去露营。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Not only he is a good student, but also he is a great athlete.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：他不仅是个好学生，还是个出色的运动员。
questions.explanation: 错误。Not only放句首引起部分倒装，助动词is应提前到主语he之前。正确：Not only is he a good student, but also he is a great athlete. Not only...but also...放句首时，Not only后的句子部分倒装。部分倒装=助动词/be/情态动词+主语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：Not only放句首引起部分倒装is+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅是个好学生，还是个出色的运动员。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The teacher suggested that the student studies harder.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：老师建议那位学生再努力学习些。
questions.explanation: 错误。suggest后的宾语从句用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。正确：The teacher suggested that the student (should) study harder. suggest/insist/demand/order等动词后的宾语从句用should+动词原形，should可省。不能用第三人称单数studies。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟进阶：suggest后宾语从句用(should)+动词原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 老师建议那位学生再努力学习些。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Seldom ___ I go to the cinema these days.
questions.questionCn: 填空：这些天我很少去电影院。
questions.explanation: Seldom是否定词，放句首引起部分倒装。助动词do提前到主语I之前。正常语序：I seldom go to the cinema these days. Seldom/Hardly/Rarely/Never等否定频率副词放句首时部分倒装。一般现在时用do/does提前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：Seldom放句首引起部分倒装do+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这些天我很少去电影院。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She is responsible ___ managing the entire project.
questions.questionCn: 填空：她负责管理整个项目。
questions.explanation: be responsible for+名词/动名词=对...负责，固定搭配。for是介词，后接动名词managing。be responsible to+人=对某人负责，be responsible for+事=对某事负责。介词搭配需记忆。responsible是形容词，后接for。
questions.knowledgePoint: 固定搭配：be responsible for+doing（对...负责）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她负责管理整个项目。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The house ___ (build) when I moved into the neighborhood.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我搬进这个社区时，房子正在建造中。
questions.explanation: when引导的时间状语从句用过去时（moved），主句表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作，用过去进行时的被动语态。结构：was/were+being+过去分词。house是build的承受者（房子被建），用被动。过去进行时被动：was being built。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时态与语态综合：过去进行时被动was being+done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我搬进这个社区时，房子正在建造中。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ is honesty that matters most in a friendship.
questions.questionCn: 填空：在友谊中，最重要的是诚实。
questions.explanation: 强调句结构：It is+被强调部分+that+其他。强调honesty（诚实）。去掉It is和that后：Honesty matters most in a friendship（仍然完整）。强调句可强调主语、宾语、状语。It is...that...是强调句的标志。
questions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It is+主语+that
questions.sentenceTranslation: 在友谊中，最重要的是诚实。

questions.question: Identify the main clause: The book that you recommended to me last week, which was written by a famous author, turned out to be very useful.
questions.questionCn: 找出主句：你上周推荐给我的那本书，是一位著名作家写的，结果非常有用。
questions.answer: The book turned out to be very useful.
questions.explanation: 主句是The book turned out to be very useful。that you recommended to me last week是限制性定语从句修饰book，which was written by a famous author是非限制性定语从句也修饰book。长难句分析：先找主句主干（主语+谓语），再分析修饰成分。定语从句是修饰成分，去掉后主句仍完整。
questions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：主句主干+定语从句修饰
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你上周推荐给我的那本书，是一位著名作家写的，结果非常有用。

questions.question: Combine using an appositive clause: He made a promise. The promise is that he will never give up.
questions.questionCn: 用同位语从句合并：他许下了一个承诺。承诺是他永不放弃。
questions.answer: He made a promise that he will never give up.
questions.explanation: 用that引导同位语从句，解释promise的内容（他永不放弃）。同位语从句紧跟在名词之后，解释名词内容。that在同位语从句中只起连接作用，不作成分，不可省略。promise that...=...的承诺。同位语从句常跟在fact/news/promise/idea等抽象名词后。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从句综合：that引导同位语从句解释promise的内容
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他许下了一个永不放弃的承诺。

questions.passage: Not until the Spring Festival did the whole family gather together. Never before had the house been so lively. Only when all the relatives arrived did the celebration begin. Hardly had the dinner started when the children began to set off fireworks. Not only did they enjoy the delicious food, but they also shared stories of the past year. So excited were the children that they stayed up until midnight. Seldom do we have such a wonderful gathering.
questions.passageCn: 直到春节全家人才聚在一起。以前这房子从未这么热闹过。只有当所有亲戚都到了，庆祝活动才开始。晚饭刚开始，孩子们就开始放烟花了。他们不仅享受了美食，还分享了过去一年的故事。孩子们太兴奋了，一直熬到午夜。我们很少有如此美好的聚会。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'Hardly had the dinner started when the children began to set off fireworks'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'Hardly had the dinner started when the children began to set off fireworks'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: Hardly...when...=一...就...，Hardly放句首时部分倒装（had提前）。had the dinner started=晚饭开始了。when引出后句。注意搭配：Hardly/Scarcely+when（不用than），No sooner+than（不用when）。部分倒装=助动词提前。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：Hardly...when...（一...就...，倒装）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 晚饭刚开始，孩子们就开始放烟花了。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'So excited were the children' uses normal word order.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'So excited were the children'使用了正常语序。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。So+形容词放句首时部分倒装，be动词were提前到主语the children之前。正常语序：The children were so excited that...。So...that=如此...以至于，So放句首倒装。部分倒装=be/助/情+主语。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 倒装综合：So+adj放句首引起部分倒装were+主语
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 孩子们太兴奋了，一直熬到午夜。

questions.passage: It was during a trip to Yunnan that I discovered the beauty of nature. It was the local people who taught me the true meaning of hospitality. Not until I climbed the mountain did I realize how small I was. What impressed me most was the sunrise over the snow-capped peaks. It is said that the lake changes color with the seasons. The moment I arrived, I knew this was a place I would never forget. It was this journey that changed my attitude toward life.
questions.passageCn: 正是在云南之旅中，我发现了自然之美。是当地人教会了我好客的真正含义。直到爬上那座山，我才意识到自己有多渺小。最让我印象深刻的是雪峰上的日出。据说那个湖会随季节变换颜色。我一到达就知道这是一个我永远不会忘记的地方。正是这次旅行改变了我对生活的态度。

subQuestions.question: 'It was during a trip to Yunnan that I discovered the beauty of nature' is an example of:
subQuestions.questionCn: 'It was during a trip to Yunnan that I discovered the beauty of nature'是：
subQuestions.explanation: It was...that...是强调句（分裂句），强调during a trip to Yunnan（时间/地点状语）。去掉It was和that后：I discovered the beauty of nature during a trip to Yunnan（仍完整）。强调句可强调各种成分，是特殊句式的重要类型。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：强调句It was+状语+that
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 正是在云南之旅中，我发现了自然之美。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Not until I climbed the mountain did I realize' uses inversion.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Not until I climbed the mountain did I realize'使用了倒装。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。Not until放句首引起部分倒装，助动词did提前到主语I之前。正常语序：I did not realize until I climbed the mountain. Not until+从句+部分倒装主句。部分倒装=助动词+主语。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 特殊句式：Not until放句首引起部分倒装did+主语
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 直到爬上那座山，我才意识到自己有多渺小。

cet6.name: 六级
cet6.description: 六级高阶突破：复杂从句、非谓语高级用法、虚拟高阶、倒装省略综合、学术写作句式、语法歧义辨析与高级固定结构，侧重长难句与学术表达。v3.0.0新增词汇解析、全句翻译及阅读理解题型。
focus: 复杂从句（多重定语从句/分隔定语从句/从句嵌套）
非谓语高级（分词独立结构/不定式被动完成/动名词逻辑主语）
虚拟高阶（混合条件句/含蓄虚拟/错综时间）
倒装与省略综合（完全倒装/虚拟倒装省if/并列省略）
学术写作句式（被动学术用法/名词化/长定语后置）
语法歧义与辨析（结构/修饰/指代歧义）
高级固定结构（rather...than/no sooner...than/however/as）
翻译与句型转换（中英转换/被动主动/长句拆分合并）

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The scientist, ___ theory was later proved correct, was once laughed at.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：那位科学家，其理论后来被证明是正确的，曾经被人嘲笑。
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句，scientist与theory是所属关系（科学家的理论），用whose。whose在非限制性定语从句中表所属，可指人指物。逗号隔开=非限制性，不能用that。whose theory=the theory of the scientist。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：非限制性定语从句whose表所属（逗号隔开不可用that）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 那位科学家，其理论后来被证明是正确的，曾经被人嘲笑。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The meeting ___ over, everyone went home.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：会议结束后，大家都回家了。
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构The meeting being over中meeting是逻辑主语，being over表状态。独立主格=名词+分词（自身有主语）。meeting与be是主动关系→being。The meeting being over=会议结束后（表时间/原因）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格（名词+现在分词being，表状态）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 会议结束后，大家都回家了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The project ___ (complete) next month is very important.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：下个月将完成的那个项目非常重要。
questions.explanation: 不定式被动式to be completed作后置定语，表将来被动。project与complete是被动关系（项目被完成），且next month表将来→to be done。不定式表将来，被动用to be done。现在分词doing表进行，过去分词done表完成。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：不定式被动式to be done作定语（表将来被动）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 下个月将完成的那个项目非常重要。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: If he had taken the medicine yesterday, he ___ better now.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果他昨天吃了药，现在就会好些了。
questions.explanation: 混合条件句：if从句与过去相反（had taken，yesterday），主句与现在相反（now→would+动词原形）。从句had taken表过去虚拟，主句now表现在虚拟→would feel。错综时间虚拟：从句和主句时间不一致，各自按对应时间虚拟。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：混合条件句（从句过去虚拟+主句现在虚拟）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他昨天吃了药，现在就会好些了。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Were it not ___ your help, I would fail.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：要不是你的帮助，我就会失败。
questions.explanation: 虚拟倒装省略if：Were it not for=If it were not for（要不是）。if虚拟条件句省略if时，were/had/should提到主语前倒装。Were it not for your help=If it were not for your help。for搭配were it not for固定。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装省略：虚拟条件句省if倒装（Were it not for=If it were not for）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是你的帮助，我就会失败。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It ___ that the earth is round.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：据证明地球是圆的。
questions.explanation: 学术写作常用被动It is proved that...（据证明...）。It是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。学术被动结构：It is said/reported/believed/proved that...。被动语态在学术写作中表客观，避免主观。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：It is proved that形式主语+被动（表客观）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据证明地球是圆的。

questions.question: Which interpretation(s) is/are possible for: 'I saw the man with a telescope.'?
questions.questionCn: 以下哪种理解是可能的：'I saw the man with a telescope.'？
choices: A. Only 'I used a telescope to see the man'
B. Only 'The man had a telescope'
C. Both A and B are possible
D. Neither A nor B makes sense
questions.explanation: 结构歧义。with a telescope可修饰saw（我用望远镜看）或the man（拿着望远镜的男人）。介词短语修饰歧义是常见语法歧义。消除歧义需语境或改写：I used a telescope to see the man / I saw the man who had a telescope.
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：介词短语修饰歧义（with a telescope修饰对象不明）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我用望远镜看到了那个男人。/ 我看到了那个拿着望远镜的男人。

questions.question: Choose the correct structure: I would rather stay at home ___ go out in the rain.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确结构：我宁愿待在家里也不冒雨出门。
questions.explanation: would rather...than...=宁愿...而不...，连接两个对等结构。rather than=而不是，表选择。would rather do A than do B。也可单独用rather than连接：He decided to walk rather than drive.
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：would rather...than...（宁愿...而不...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我宁愿待在家里也不冒雨出门。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: No sooner ___ home than it began to rain.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我刚到家就开始下雨了。
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...否定词开头部分倒装，had提到主语前。No sooner had I reached home than...=我刚到家就下雨。No sooner...than=一...就...，had+过去分词提到主语前=部分倒装。主句用过去完成时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...部分倒装（had+主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我刚到家就开始下雨了。

questions.question: Choose the best translation for: 只有这样我们才能解决问题。
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳翻译：只有这样我们才能解决问题。
choices: A. Only in this way we can solve the problem
B. Only in this way can we solve the problem
C. Only in this way we could solve the problem
D. Only in this way could solve the problem
questions.explanation: Only+状语置于句首，主句部分倒装：can we solve。中英句式转换：中文'只有...才'对应Only...can，且Only开头需倒装。Only in this way can we...=只有这样我们才能...。部分倒装：can提到we前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：中文'只有...才'→Only+倒装句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 只有这样我们才能解决问题。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The book which I borrowed it from the library is interesting.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。
questions.explanation: 错误。which已在从句中作borrowed的宾语（borrowed the book→borrowed which），it是多余宾语。正确：The book which I borrowed from the library is interesting. 定语从句关系代词作宾语时，从句不能再出现该宾语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：关系代词作宾语后从句不能再重复宾语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The report having been discussed, the committee made a decision.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：报告讨论完毕后，委员会做出了决定。
questions.explanation: 正确。Having been discussed是独立主格的完成被动式，report与discuss是被动关系（报告被讨论），且讨论发生在决定之前。名词+having been done=独立主格完成被动，表被动且先于主句。结构：The report having been discussed, ...
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格完成被动式（名词+having been done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 报告讨论完毕后，委员会做出了决定。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Without your help, I will fail the exam.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：没有你的帮助，我就会考试不及格。
questions.explanation: 错误。Without表含蓄虚拟（=If there were no），与现在/将来相反用would+动词原形。正确：Without your help, I would fail the exam. 含蓄虚拟词：without/but for/or else，后接would/could/should+动词原形。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：without含蓄虚拟（=if条件句，用would）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 没有你的帮助，我就会考试不及格。

questions.question: Judge true or false: In 'The research conducted by the team was published in a journal.', 'conducted by the team' is a past participle phrase used as a post-modifier.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：在'The research conducted by the team was published in a journal.'中，conducted by the team是过去分词短语作后置定语。
questions.explanation: 正确。conducted by the team是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰the research。research与conduct是被动关系（研究被进行）→过去分词conducted。长定语后置是学术写作特点：名词+过去分词短语，=which was conducted by the team。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：过去分词短语作长后置定语（=which was done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 团队进行的研究发表在了一本期刊上。

questions.question: Judge true or false: 'Flying planes can be dangerous.' has only one meaning.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：'Flying planes can be dangerous.'只有一种意思。
questions.explanation: 错误。此句有两种理解：1)flying planes（飞行中的飞机）can be dangerous（很危险）；2)Flying planes（驾驶飞机）can be dangerous（很危险）。现在分词flying修饰歧义：作定语（飞行的飞机）vs作动名词主语（驾驶飞机）。结构歧义需语境消除。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：现在分词flying修饰歧义（定语vs动名词主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 飞行中的飞机可能很危险。/ 驾驶飞机可能很危险。

questions.question: Judge true or false: 'People say that he is honest.' can be converted to the passive form 'It is said that he is honest.'
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：'People say that he is honest.'可以转换为被动形式'It is said that he is honest.'。
questions.explanation: 正确。主动People say that→被动It is said that...（据说）。People say+that从句→It is said that+从句。主动变被动句型转换：主语People→形式主语It，谓语say→is said。It is said/reported/believed that是常见被动句型。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：People say that→It is said that被动句型转换
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他很诚实。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He left the room, ___ (follow) by his dog.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他离开了房间，身后跟着他的狗。
questions.explanation: 分词作伴随状语，he与follow是被动关系（被跟随），用过去分词followed。followed by his dog=被他的狗跟着。分词作状语看与主句主语关系：主动用doing，被动用done。he是被跟的对象→followed。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：分词作伴随状语，被动用followed by
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他离开了房间，身后跟着他的狗。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (criticize) by the teacher made the boy cry.
questions.questionCn: 填空：被老师批评让男孩哭了。
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语，the boy与criticize是被动关系，用动名词被动式being done。Being criticized=被批评这件事。动名词作主语表'做某事'，被动用being done。Being criticized made the boy cry=被批评让他哭了。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：动名词被动式being done作主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 被老师批评让男孩哭了。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Here ___ (come) the bus!
questions.questionCn: 填空：公交车来了！
questions.explanation: 完全倒装：表地点的副词(here/there)开头+谓语+主语（名词）。Here comes the bus=公交车来了。完全倒装规则：副词(here/there/up/down)+动词+主语（名词），主语是代词则不倒装(Here it comes)。comes与the bus（名词）倒装。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装省略：here/there完全倒装（名词主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 公交车来了！

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It is necessary that every student ___ (hand in) the homework on time.
questions.questionCn: 填空：每个学生必须按时交作业。
questions.explanation: It is necessary/important/essential that+主语从句用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。It is necessary that every student (should) hand in...=每个学生必须按时交作业。形容词necessary/important/essential后主语从句用should do（should可省）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：It is necessary that+主语从句虚拟(should do)
questions.sentenceTranslation: 每个学生必须按时交作业。

questions.question: Clarify the two meanings of 'Visiting relatives can be boring' by completing both paraphrases: 1) ___ to visit relatives can be boring. 2) Relatives ___ visit us can be boring.
questions.questionCn: 用释义消除歧义，补全两种理解：'Visiting relatives can be boring'。1)去拜访亲戚很无聊。2)来访的亲戚很无聊。
questions.explanation: 结构歧义。visiting relatives可理解为：1)动名词visiting+宾语relatives（去拜访亲戚）；2)现在分词visiting+名词relatives（来访的亲戚）。消除歧义用不定式/关系从句改写：To visit relatives... / Relatives who visit...
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：visiting relatives同形歧义（动名词vs现在分词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 去拜访亲戚可能很无聊。/ 来访的亲戚可能很无聊。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ hard he tried, he could not solve the problem.
questions.questionCn: 填空：无论他多么努力，都解决不了这个问题。
questions.explanation: However引导让步状语从句：However+adj/adv+主语+谓语。However hard he tried=无论他多么努力。however=无论多么，后接形容词/副词。结构：However+adj/adv+主语+谓语。对比no matter how+adj/adv同义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：However+adj/adv引导让步从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 无论他多么努力，都解决不了这个问题。

questions.question: Combine into one sentence: The day will come. You will regret your words then.
questions.questionCn: 合并为一句：那一天总会到来。到那时你会后悔你说的话。
questions.answer: The day will come when you will regret your words.
questions.explanation: when引导定语从句修饰the day，因从句长为避免头重脚轻后置（分隔定语从句）。when=on that day。结构：主句+when从句（后置）。分隔定语从句：先行词与定语从句被谓语等成分隔开。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：分隔定语从句（先行词与从句分离，避免头重脚轻）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你后悔自己话语的那一天总会到来。

questions.question: Rewrite using 'but for': If it had not rained, we would have gone camping.
questions.questionCn: 用but for改写：要不是下雨，我们就去露营了。
questions.answer: But for the rain, we would have gone camping.
questions.explanation: but for表含蓄虚拟，=if it had not been for。与过去相反用would have done。but for the rain=要不是下雨。含蓄虚拟结构：but for/without+名词+would have done/would do。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：but for含蓄虚拟（=if it had not been for）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是下雨，我们就去露营了。

questions.question: Rewrite using 'nor/neither': He can't speak French. I can't speak French either.
questions.questionCn: 用nor/neither改写：他不会说法语。我也不会。
questions.answer: He can't speak French, nor can I.
questions.explanation: 否定句后接nor/neither+be/助/情+主语=也不。前句can't否定，后句nor can I=我也不能。nor/neither开头部分倒装：情态动词can提到I前。结构：nor/neither+情态/助/be+主语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装省略：nor/neither否定倒装（nor+情态+主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不会说法语，我也不会。

questions.question: Explain the ambiguity in: 'They fed her dog biscuits.' Give two interpretations.
questions.questionCn: 解释歧义：'They fed her dog biscuits.'给出两种理解。
questions.answer: 1) They fed biscuits to her dog. 2) They fed her dog-biscuits.
questions.explanation: 结构歧义。her dog biscuits可理解为：1)her dog是fed的宾语，biscuits是补语（喂她狗吃饼干，即fed biscuits to her dog）；2)dog biscuits是复合名词（狗饼干），her修饰（喂她狗饼干）。双宾语vs复合名词结构歧义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：双宾语vs复合名词结构歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他们喂她的狗吃了饼干。/ 他们喂她吃狗饼干。

questions.question: Split into two simple sentences: The boy who is wearing a red coat is my brother.
questions.questionCn: 拆分为两个简单句：穿红色外套的男孩是我弟弟。
questions.answer: The boy is my brother. He is wearing a red coat.
questions.explanation: 长句拆分：定语从句拆为独立句。who is wearing a red coat修饰the boy，拆分后用He指代the boy作独立句主语。长句拆分技巧：找从句→拆为独立句→用代词衔接。合并则用定语从句连接。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：长句拆分（定语从句→独立句+代词衔接）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 穿红色外套的男孩是我弟弟。

questions.passage: It has been widely argued that the findings reported in this study, which were obtained through a rigorous experimental design, challenge the prevailing assumption that intelligence is fixed. The data, having been collected over a period of five years, indicate that cognitive abilities can be significantly enhanced through targeted training. It is therefore recommended that further research be conducted to explore the mechanisms underlying this phenomenon.
questions.passageCn: 人们普遍认为，本研究报告的发现——这些发现是通过严格的实验设计获得的——挑战了智力是固定不变的这一普遍假设。经过五年时间收集的数据表明，认知能力可以通过有针对性的训练得到显著提升。因此，建议开展进一步研究以探索这一现象背后的机制。

subQuestions.question: What function does 'which were obtained through a rigorous experimental design' serve in the passage?
subQuestions.questionCn: 短文中'which were obtained through a rigorous experimental design'起什么作用？
choices: B. 非限制性定语从句（补充说明findings）
subQuestions.explanation: which引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明the findings（先行词指物用which）。逗号隔开表非限制性，which were obtained=被发现/获得。which在从句中作主语。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：非限制性定语从句which（逗号隔开，指物作主语）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 本研究报告的发现是通过严格的实验设计获得的。

subQuestions.question: True or False: In 'It is therefore recommended that further research be conducted', 'be conducted' is in the subjunctive mood (should be omitted).
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：在'It is therefore recommended that further research be conducted'中，'be conducted'用了虚拟语气（省略了should）。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。recommend后的主语从句用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。should be conducted省略should后为be conducted。recommend/demand/suggest/insist等动词后的从句用should do（should可省）。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：recommend后主语从句虚拟(should do，should可省)
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 因此，建议开展进一步研究。

questions.passage: The old man, who had spent his entire life in the village where he was born, refused to leave even when his children, all of whom had settled in the city, begged him to move. 'This is the place that holds my memories,' he said, 'and no matter what happens, I will never abandon the house that my father built with his own hands.' What his children did not understand was that the house meant more to him than just shelter.
questions.passageCn: 那位老人，他在自己出生的村庄里度过了整整一生，即使他的孩子们——他们全都已在城市安家——恳求他搬走，他也拒绝离开。'这个地方承载着我的回忆，'他说，'无论发生什么，我都永远不会放弃我父亲亲手建造的这栋房子。'他的孩子们不理解的是，这栋房子对他来说远不止是一个住所。

subQuestions.question: How many relative clauses are there in the first sentence of the passage?
subQuestions.questionCn: 短文第一句中有几个定语从句？
subQuestions.explanation: 第一句含三个定语从句：1)who had spent...修饰the old man；2)where he was born修饰the village；3)all of whom had settled in the city修饰his children。多重定语从句嵌套是六级复杂从句的典型特征。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：多重定语从句嵌套（who+where+whom）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 那位在自己出生的村庄里度过了一生的老人，即使孩子们恳求他搬走，他也拒绝离开。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'What his children did not understand was that the house meant more to him than just shelter' contains both a subject clause and a predicative clause.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'What his children did not understand was that...'中同时包含主语从句和表语从句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。What his children did not understand是主语从句（what作understand的宾语），was后that the house meant more...是表语从句。一个句子中嵌套主语从句+表语从句是复杂从句结构。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：主语从句(what)+表语从句(that)嵌套
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 他的孩子们不理解的是，这栋房子对他来说远不止是一个住所。

questions.passage: No sooner had the new policy been announced than critics began to voice their concerns. Not only did they argue that the measures were impractical, but they also pointed out that the government had failed to consult the public. However hard the officials tried to defend the policy, the opposition remained strong. The controversy was such that the matter was referred to a special committee, whose task was to review the proposal in detail.
questions.passageCn: 新政策一公布，批评者就开始表达他们的担忧。他们不仅认为这些措施不切实际，还指出政府未能征求公众意见。无论官员们多么努力地为政策辩护，反对声依然强烈。争议如此之大，以至于此事被提交给了一个特别委员会，其任务是详细审查该提案。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'No sooner had the new policy been announced than critics began to voice their concerns'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'No sooner had the new policy been announced than...'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: No sooner...than...否定词开头部分倒装，had提到主语the new policy前。No sooner had...than...=一...就...。部分倒装：助动词/情态/be提到主语前。had been announced是过去完成时被动。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...部分倒装+被动语态
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 新政策一公布，批评者就开始表达他们的担忧。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'However hard the officials tried' uses 'However' to introduce an adverbial clause of concession.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'However hard the officials tried'用However引导让步状语从句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。However+adj/adv+主语+谓语引导让步状语从句。However hard=无论多么努力。However=无论多么，后接副词hard。对比no matter how同义。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：However+adv引导让步从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 无论官员们多么努力地为政策辩护，反对声依然强烈。

subQuestions.question: What does 'such that' mean in 'The controversy was such that the matter was referred to a special committee'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 在'The controversy was such that...'中，'such that'是什么意思？
subQuestions.explanation: such that=如此...以至于。such是代词指代争议的程度，that引导结果状语从句。The controversy was such that...=争议如此之大以至于...。such...that结构与so...that同义但用法不同。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：such that引导结果状语从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 争议如此之大，以至于此事被提交给了一个特别委员会。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The day will come ___ we can travel to space easily.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：我们能轻松地去太空旅行的那一天终将到来。
questions.explanation: 这是分隔定语从句。先行词The day与定语从句被will come分隔。when是关系副词，修饰表时间的先行词The day，在从句中作时间状语。分隔定语从句：先行词与定语从句之间插入了谓语动词或其他成分，造成分隔。= The day when we can travel to space easily will come. when=on which。关系副词when修饰时间名词，where修饰地点名词，why修饰reason。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：分隔定语从句，when修饰先行词The day
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们能轻松地去太空旅行的那一天终将到来。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Weather ___, we will go camping tomorrow.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：天气允许的话，我们明天去露营。
questions.explanation: 这是独立主格结构。Weather与permit是主动关系（天气允许），用现在分词permitting。独立主格：名词/代词+分词/形容词/副词/不定式，逻辑主语与主句主语不同。Weather permitting=天气允许的话（Weather是permitting的逻辑主语，与主句主语we不同）。独立主格表条件、原因、伴随等。= If weather permits, we will go camping tomorrow. 英语独立主格结构用分词形式，是高级语法点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格Weather permitting（名词+现在分词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 天气允许的话，我们明天去露营。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: If he had followed my advice then, he ___ in trouble now.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果他当时听了我的建议，他现在就不会有麻烦了。
questions.explanation: 这是错综时间虚拟语气（混合条件句）。if从句与过去相反（had followed），但主句有now，与现在相反（would not be）。if从句用过去完成时had followed（过去的过去），主句用would+动词原形be（与现在相反）。错综时间虚拟：从句和主句时间不一致，各自用对应时态。判断关键：if从句时间词then→过去完成时；主句时间词now→would+原形。这是高级虚拟语气难点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气高阶：错综时间，if从句过去完成时+主句would+原形（现在）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他当时听了我的建议，他现在就不会有麻烦了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ it rain tomorrow, we would have to cancel the trip.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果明天下雨，我们就不得不取消旅行。
questions.explanation: 这是虚拟条件句的倒装省略形式。在虚拟条件句中，如果省略if，需将were/should/had提到主语前。Should it rain=If it should rain（如果万一明天下雨）。与将来相反的虚拟：if从句用should+原形/过去式/were to+原形。省略if倒装：Should it rain（should提前），Were it to rain（were提前），Had it rained（had提前，表过去）。should提前表'万一'，语气较弱。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：虚拟条件句省略if→Should+主语+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果明天下雨，我们就不得不取消旅行。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It ___ that regular exercise can significantly improve mental health.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：据证实，规律的运动能显著改善心理健康。
questions.explanation: 学术写作中常用It is/was+过去分词+that从句的被动结构。此处表已证实的研究结论，用现在完成时被动has been shown。It是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。学术被动结构：It is widely acknowledged that...（人们普遍认为），It has been shown that...（已证实），It is reported that...（据报道）。学术英语倾向用被动语态使表达更客观。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术写作：It has been shown that...（形式主语+被动+真正主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据证实，规律的运动能显著改善心理健康。

questions.question: Choose the sentence with NO ambiguity:
questions.questionCn: 选择没有歧义的句子：
choices: A. I saw the man with the telescope.
B. I saw the man using the telescope.
C. I used the telescope to see the man.
D. I saw the man who had a telescope.
questions.explanation: A有歧义：with the telescope可修饰saw（用望远镜看）或the man（带望远镜的男人）。B有歧义：using可修饰saw或the man。D有歧义：who had a telescope修饰the man，但'有望远镜'的人是否在看不明。C无歧义：I used the telescope to see the man.（我用望远镜看那个男人。）句意明确，主语I执行used和saw。语法歧义常因修饰语位置或介词短语归属不明造成。学术写作应避免歧义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：介词短语with the telescope修饰歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我用望远镜看那个男人。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ had we arrived at the airport than the flight was cancelled.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我们刚到机场，航班就取消了。
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...=一...就...，固定结构。No sooner置于句首时主句部分倒装。No sooner had we arrived=我们刚到。搭配：No sooner...than...（一...就...），Hardly/Scarcely...when...（刚...就...）。注意搭配不可混淆：No sooner配than，Hardly/Scarcely配when。No sooner+had+主语+过去分词+than+从句。= We had no sooner arrived than the flight was cancelled.
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...（一...就...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们刚到机场，航班就取消了。

questions.question: Choose the best transformation of: 'People say that he is a genius.' (Passive)
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳转换：'人们说他是个天才。'（被动语态）
choices: A. He is said to be a genius.
B. He is said that he is a genius.
C. It is said he to be a genius.
D. A genius is said he is.
questions.explanation: People say that he is a genius.转换为被动：It is said that he is a genius. 或 He is said to be a genius. 后者更简洁：主语he+is said+to be（不定式）。不定式时态：to be（同时/现在），to have been（过去）。= It is said that he is a genius. = He is said to be a genius. 被动转换使主语变为原从句主语he，用不定式to be替代that从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与转换：He is said to be...（被动+不定式替代that从句）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他是个天才。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The book that I borrowed it from the library is very interesting.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。
questions.explanation: 错误。that在定语从句中作borrowed的宾语，不能再加it，造成宾语重复。正确：The book that I borrowed from the library is very interesting. 关系代词that/which/who在从句中作宾语时，that本身即宾语，不需再加代词。= The book which I borrowed... 或 The book I borrowed...（作宾语可省略）。英语定语从句中关系代词已经充当成分，不能重复添加宾语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：关系代词that作宾语时不可再加it
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。

questions.question: Judge true or false: With all the work finished, we can go home now.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：所有工作都完成了，我们现在可以回家了。
questions.explanation: 正确。With+宾语+过去分词构成with复合结构。all the work与finish是被动关系（工作被完成），用过去分词finished。With all the work finished=所有工作完成后（表原因/条件）。with复合结构：With+宾语+宾补（分词/形容词/副词/不定式/介词短语）。主动用doing，被动用done。= Because all the work has been finished, we can go home.
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：with复合结构，With+宾语+过去分词finished
questions.sentenceTranslation: 所有工作都完成了，我们现在可以回家了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: But for your help, I will not succeed.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：要不是你的帮助，我是不会成功的。
questions.explanation: 错误。But for=要不是，引导含蓄虚拟语气，需用虚拟语气。与现在事实相反用would+原形，与过去相反用would have+过去分词。句意'要不是你的帮助，我不会成功'与现在/过去相反。正确：But for your help, I would not succeed.（与现在相反）或 But for your help, I would not have succeeded.（与过去相反）。含蓄虚拟：but for, without, but that等隐含条件，需用虚拟语气。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气高阶：But for+虚拟语气（would+原形/have done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是你的帮助，我是不会成功的。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Try as he might, he could not solve the problem.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：尽管他尽力了，他还是无法解决这个问题。
questions.explanation: 正确。as引导让步状语从句时用倒装：动词原形/形容词/副词/名词+as+主语+谓语。Try as he might=尽管他尽力。as让步倒装结构：①动词原形+as+主语+助动词（Try as he might）；②形容词+as+主语+be（Young as he is）；③名词+as+主语+谓语（Child as he is）。as=though/although，但语序特殊。英语as让步倒装是固定结构，需熟练掌握。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：as让步倒装，动词原形+as+主语+助动词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 尽管他尽力了，他还是无法解决这个问题。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: A survey ___ (conduct) among college students reveals interesting findings.
questions.questionCn: 填空：一项在大学生中进行的调查揭示了有趣的发现。
questions.explanation: conducted是过去分词作后置定语修饰survey。survey与conduct是被动关系（调查被进行），用过去分词conducted。= A survey which was conducted among college students... 学术写作中常用过去分词作后置定语使句子简洁。名词化：将动词conduct转为过去分词conducted作定语。学术写作特点：多用被动、名词化、分词定语，使表达更正式客观。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术写作：过去分词conducted作后置定语表被动（名词化）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 一项在大学生中进行的调查揭示了有趣的发现。

questions.question: Fill in the blank to remove ambiguity: I gave the book to ___ (make clear: not him, but her).
questions.questionCn: 填空以消除歧义：我把书给了___（明确：不是给他，而是给她）。
questions.explanation: 歧义句I gave the book to him/her中，若主语和宾语代词模糊，会造成理解困难。用明确代词her消除歧义。语法歧义类型：①修饰歧义（with the telescope修饰谁）；②指代歧义（he指谁）；③结构歧义（old men and women的分组）。消除歧义方法：①调整语序；②使用明确代词；③添加逗号或重写。学术写作应避免代词指代不明。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：代词指代明确化消除歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我把书给了她。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: However difficult the task is, we will try ___ best to complete it.
questions.questionCn: 填空：无论任务多困难，我们都会尽全力完成它。
questions.explanation: try one's best=尽某人全力，固定搭配。主语是we，用our best。try one's best中one's随主语变化：I→my, you→your, he→his, she→her, we→our, they→their。However引导让步状语从句：However+形容词/副词+主语+谓语=无论多么...。However difficult the task is=无论任务多难。= No matter how difficult the task is。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：try one's best + However引导让步从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 无论任务多困难，我们都会尽全力完成它。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (not only...but also转换) does he speak English, but he also writes it well.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他不仅会说英语，而且写得也很好。（not only...but also倒装转换）
questions.explanation: Not only置于句首时，前半句部分倒装。原句：He not only speaks English but also writes it well. 转换：Not only does he speak English, but he also writes it well. 倒装：Not only+助动词does+主语he+动词原形speak。but also后不倒装。句型转换技巧：把not only从句中提到句首→倒装。强调'不仅...而且'中的前半部分。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与转换：not only句首→部分倒装does he speak
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅会说英语，而且写得也很好。

questions.question: Rewrite using mixed conditional: 如果我当时努力学习，我现在就通过考试了。（if从句与过去相反，主句与现在相反）
questions.questionCn: 用混合条件句改写：如果我当时努力学习，我现在就通过考试了。
questions.answer: If I had studied hard then, I would pass the exam now.
questions.explanation: 错综时间混合条件句：if从句与过去相反（had studied），主句与现在相反（would pass）。if从句用过去完成时had+过去分词（表过去未发生），主句用would+动词原形（表现在的结果）。判断关键：if从句时间词then→过去完成时；主句时间词now→would+原形。混合条件句是虚拟语气高级用法，从句和主句时间不同，各自用对应形式。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气高阶：混合条件句，if从句过去完成时+主句would+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我当时努力学习，我现在就通过考试了。

questions.question: Transform into a passive sentence: 大家认为他是这个项目最合适的人选。
questions.questionCn: 转换为被动句：大家认为他是这个项目最合适的人选。
questions.answer: He is considered to be the most suitable person for the project.
questions.explanation: 主动句'大家认为他是...'转换为被动句：He is considered to be...。结构：主语(he)+被动谓语(is considered)+不定式(to be)+表语。consider sb to be sth（认为某人是...）→sb is considered to be sth。不定式时态：to be（同时/现在），to have been（过去）。被动+不定式替代that从句，使表达更简洁正式。= It is considered that he is the most suitable person...
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与转换：被动转换He is considered to be...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他被认为是这个项目最合适的人选。

questions.passage: It was a cold winter morning when the children decided to build a snowman. The snow, which had fallen heavily during the night, was perfect for rolling. What excited them most was the idea of decorating it with colorful scarves. The snowman they built was so tall that it could be seen from across the street. Not until the sun came out did they realize how cold their hands had become. Nevertheless, the joy they experienced was something they would never forget.
questions.passageCn: 那是一个寒冷的冬日早晨，孩子们决定堆一个雪人。夜里下的大雪非常适合滚雪球。最让他们兴奋的是用彩色围巾装饰雪人的想法。他们堆的雪人很高，从街对面都能看到。直到太阳出来，他们才意识到自己的手已经变得多冷。然而，他们体验到的快乐是他们永远不会忘记的。

subQuestions.question: What type of clause is 'when the children decided to build a snowman'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'when the children decided to build a snowman'是什么类型的从句？
subQuestions.explanation: when引导时间状语从句，修饰主句It was a cold winter morning，说明事情发生的时间。when=当...的时候。注意：when也可引导定语从句（修饰时间名词，如the day when...），但此处morning前有a，且when从句修饰整个主句而非morning，故为状语从句。区分关键：when从句是否紧跟在时间名词后且修饰该名词。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：when引导时间状语从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 那是一个寒冷的冬日早晨，孩子们决定堆一个雪人。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Not until the sun came out did they realize' uses inversion correctly.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Not until the sun came out did they realize'正确使用了倒装。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。Not until置于句首时，主句部分倒装。Not until+时间状语从句+did+主语+动词原形。Not until the sun came out did they realize=直到太阳出来他们才意识到。部分倒装：did they realize（did提前）。= They did not realize until the sun came out. Not until倒装强调时间。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与从句：Not until句首→主句部分倒装did they realize
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 直到太阳出来，他们才意识到自己的手已经变得多冷。

questions.passage: Last summer, our family went on a trip to Yunnan. No sooner had we arrived than we were captivated by the beautiful scenery. The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore. Try as we might to follow the schedule, we kept getting lost in the charming old towns. It was not until the third day that we found our way around. However tired we were, the trip was worth every moment. We would rather have stayed longer, but time was limited.
questions.passageCn: 去年夏天，我们全家去云南旅行。我们刚到就被美丽的风景迷住了。我们越旅行，就越想探索更多。尽管我们努力按照行程走，还是不断在迷人的古镇里迷路。直到第三天我们才找到路。无论多累，这趟旅行每一刻都值得。我们宁愿多待一段时间，但时间有限。

subQuestions.question: Which structure is used in 'The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: The+比较级..., the+比较级...=越...越...。The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore=我们越旅行，越想探索。此结构前后两个the+比较级对应，表两个事物同向变化。比较级可换形容词：The harder you work, the better you will be.（越努力越好。）固定结构，两半句都用the+比较级开头。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：The+比较级..., the+比较级...（越...越...）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 我们越旅行，就越想探索更多。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Try as we might' is an inversion structure meaning 'although we tried'.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Try as we might'是倒装结构，意为'尽管我们努力了'。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。as引导让步状语从句时用倒装：动词原形+as+主语+助动词。Try as we might=尽管我们尽力。as=although/though，但语序特殊。as让步倒装变体：①动词原形+as+主语+助动词（Try as we might）；②形容词+as+主语+be（Tired as we were）；③名词+as+主语+谓语。= Although we tried hard, we kept getting lost.
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：as让步倒装Try as we might=although
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 尽管我们努力按照行程走，还是不断迷路。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The day will come ___ people can travel to Mars.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：人类能去火星旅行的那一天终将到来。
questions.explanation: 先行词The day表时间，在从句中作时间状语，用关系副词when。when=on which。that/which在定语从句中须作主/宾语不作状语。先行词表时间，从句缺时间状语用when。分隔定语从句：先行词与定语从句被will come隔开。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：分隔定语从句，先行词表时间用when
questions.sentenceTranslation: 人类能去火星旅行的那一天终将到来。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ from space, the earth looks like a blue ball.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：从太空看，地球像一个蓝色的球。
questions.explanation: 过去分词作状语，主语the earth与see是被动关系（地球被看），用过去分词Seen。Seen from space=When the earth is seen from space。过去分词表被动。注意：逻辑主语是earth（被看）不是人（看），所以用seen不用seeing。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：过去分词作状语表被动（逻辑主语earth被看）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 从太空看，地球像一个蓝色的球。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: If he ___ harder last year, he would have passed the exam.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果他去年更努力，他就能通过考试了。
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句：if从句用过去完成时had studied，主句用would have+过去分词。last year表过去，'如果去年更努力'与过去事实相反。结构：if+had done，主句would have done。表过去未实现的假设。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：与过去相反，if+had done，主句would have done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他去年更努力，他就能通过考试了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ , he would have succeeded.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果他再努力一些，他就能成功了。
questions.explanation: 虚拟条件句省略if的倒装：Had+主语+过去分词=If+主语+had done。Had he worked harder=If he had worked harder。与过去相反的虚拟条件句省略if时，had提前倒装。省略if+had提前=虚拟倒装。主句would have succeeded。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：虚拟条件句省略if，had提前倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他再努力一些，他就能成功了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It is generally accepted ___ exercise is beneficial to health.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：人们普遍认为运动有益健康。
questions.explanation: It is accepted that...=人们认为...，that引导主语从句（it是形式主语）。从句成分完整（exercise is beneficial），不缺成分，用that。that只起连接作用不作成分。学术写作常用It is+过去分词+that从句（被动句式表客观）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术写作：It is accepted that...（被动表客观）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 人们普遍认为运动有益健康。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: I will remember the day ___ we spent together forever.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：我会永远记住我们一起度过的那一天。
questions.explanation: 先行词the day，在从句中作spent的宾语（度过了那一天），用which/that。when=in/on which作时间状语不作宾语。区分：the day which we spent（which作宾语，spent the day）vs the day when we met（when作状语，met on the day）。判断关系词是否作成分。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法辨析：定语从句which作宾语vs when作状语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我会永远记住我们一起度过的那一天。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ had I sat down when the phone rang.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我刚坐下电话就响了。
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...=一...就...。No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang。No sooner放句首倒装（had提前）。Hardly...when...和Scarcely...when...也表'一...就'，但搭配不同：No sooner+than，Hardly/Scarcely+when。注意搭配不可混用。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...（一...就...，倒装）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我刚坐下电话就响了。

questions.question: Choose the best translation: 直到老师解释了第二遍，学生们才理解这个概念。
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳翻译：直到老师解释了第二遍，学生们才理解这个概念。
choices: A. Not until the teacher explained it a second time did the students understand the concept.
B. The students didn't understand until the teacher explained it a second time.
C. Both A and B are correct
questions.explanation: 两种翻译都正确：A用倒装（Not until放句首→did提前倒装），B用正常语序（not...until=直到...才）。Not until+状语放句首时倒装，放句中时不倒装。两种结构表达同一意思：直到...才。倒装和正常语序都可正确表达。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：Not until放句首倒装 vs 句中不倒装（两种都对）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到老师解释了第二遍，学生们才理解这个概念。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: This is the most interesting book ___ I have ever read.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：这是我读过的最有趣的书。
questions.explanation: 先行词有最高级most interesting修饰时，关系代词只能用that不能用which。规则：先行词有最高级/序数词/the only/the very修饰，或先行词既有人又有物时，用that不用which。what不能引导定语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：先行词有最高级修饰用that不用which
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这是我读过的最有趣的书。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Weather ___, we will go hiking tomorrow.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：天气允许的话，我们明天去远足。
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构名词+现在分词，weather与permit是主动关系（天气允许），用现在分词permitting。Weather permitting=If weather permits。独立主格自带主语weather（与主句we不同）。现在分词表主动，过去分词表被动。天气主动允许→permitting。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格名词+doing表主动（weather permitting）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 天气允许的话，我们明天去远足。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Without your help, I ___ the task on time.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：没有你的帮助，我不可能按时完成任务。
questions.explanation: 含蓄虚拟语气，Without=If it had not been for（如果没有），表与过去事实相反。主句用would have+过去分词。Without your help=If you had not helped me。'没有帮助→不可能完成'是过去的假设，用would have completed。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：含蓄虚拟Without=If it had not been for，主句would have done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 没有你的帮助，我不可能按时完成任务。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Child ___, he knows a lot about science.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：虽然他是个孩子，但他懂很多科学知识。
questions.explanation: as引导让步状语从句时用倒装：名词/形容词/动词原形+as+主语+be/助动词。Child as he is=Although he is a child。as=although/though但语序特殊。注意：名词放as前时不加冠词（Child不用A child）。表'虽然...但是'。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：as让步倒装名词+as+主语+be=although
questions.sentenceTranslation: 虽然他是个孩子，但他懂很多科学知识。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The reason why he was late was because he missed the bus.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：他迟到的原因是因为他没赶上公交车。
questions.explanation: 错误。The reason...is/was that...中用that不用because，避免reason和because语义重复。正确：The reason why he was late was that he missed the bus. why引导定语从句修饰reason，that引导表语从句。reason和because不能同时用。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：The reason...that...不用because（避免语义重复）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他迟到的原因是他没赶上公交车。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The problem having been solved, we went home happily.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：问题解决后，我们高兴地回家了。
questions.explanation: 正确。独立主格结构名词+分词完成式被动：The problem having been solved=After the problem had been solved。problem与solve是被动关系（问题被解决）且先于主句动作，用having been done（完成式被动）。自带主语problem（与主句we不同）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格名词+having been done表被动完成
questions.sentenceTranslation: 问题解决后，我们高兴地回家了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: If I would have known, I would have told you.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：如果我知道的话，我就告诉你了。
questions.explanation: 错误。与过去相反的虚拟条件句if从句应用过去完成时had known，不能用would have known。正确：If I had known, I would have told you. if从句用had done，主句用would have done。would只在主句用，if从句不能用would。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：if从句用had done不用would have done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我知道的话，我就告诉你了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Were it not for your help, I would have failed.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：要不是你的帮助，我就失败了。
questions.explanation: 正确。虚拟条件句省略if的倒装：Were it not for=If it were not for（要不是因为）。与现在/将来相反用were，were提前省if。Were it not for your help=If it were not for your help。省略if+were提前=虚拟倒装。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：虚拟条件句省略if，were提前倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是你的帮助，我就失败了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: 'The shooting of the hunters was terrible' is a sentence with no ambiguity.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：'猎人的射击很可怕'这句话没有歧义。
questions.explanation: 错误。The shooting of the hunters有歧义：①猎人射击（shooting=射击，hunters是执行者）；②射击猎人（shooting=射击，hunters是承受者）。of可表动宾关系（射击猎人）或主谓关系（猎人射击）。这是名词化结构的典型歧义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法辨析：名词化结构of表动宾/主谓关系的歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 猎人的射击很可怕。（或：射击猎人很可怕。）

questions.question: Judge true or false: The more you practice, the better you will become.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：你练习得越多，就会变得越好。
questions.explanation: 正确。The+比较级..., the+比较级...=越...越...。The more you practice=你练习越多，the better you will become=你变得越好。两个the+比较级对应，表两个事物同向变化。固定结构：The+比较级..., the+比较级...
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：The+比较级..., the+比较级...（越...越...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你练习得越多，就会变得越好。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is the only one of the students who ___ passed the exam.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他是唯一通过考试的学生。
questions.explanation: 在the only one of+n.+复数+定语从句中，定语从句修饰the only one（单数），谓语用单数has。one of+n.+复数+从句时从句修饰复数用复数；the only one of+n.+复数+从句时从句修饰the only one用单数。关键看the only one。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：the only one of+复数，从句修饰the only one用单数
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他是唯一通过考试的学生。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (not finish) his homework, he was not allowed to watch TV.
questions.questionCn: 填空：因为没完成作业，他不许看电视。
questions.explanation: 现在分词完成式的否定形式作原因状语。Not having finished=Because he had not finished。先没完成作业（先于主句）→不许看TV（后），用Having done的完成式表先于主句，否定加Not在前。主语he主动没完成→Not having finished。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：Not having done作原因状语（否定完成式，先于主句）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 因为没完成作业，他不许看电视。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It is essential that every student ___ (wear) a uniform.
questions.questionCn: 填空：每个学生都必须穿校服。
questions.explanation: It is essential that+从句用虚拟语气should+动词原形，should可省。essential/important/necessary/urgent等形容词后的主语从句用(should)+动词原形。wear用原形不加s。这类表'必须/重要'的形容词后从句用虚拟语气。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：It is essential that+(should)+动词原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 每个学生都必须穿校服。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ it not for the rain, we would have a picnic.
questions.questionCn: 填空：要不是下雨，我们就去野餐了。
questions.explanation: 虚拟条件句省略if的倒装：Were it not for=If it were not for（要不是因为）。与现在事实相反用were，were提前省if。Were it not for the rain=If it were not for the rain。省略if+were提前=虚拟倒装。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：虚拟条件句省略if，were提前倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是下雨，我们就去野餐了。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I have no doubt ___ he will succeed.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我毫不怀疑他会成功。
questions.explanation: 同位语从句，that解释doubt的内容（他会成功）。that只起连接作用不作成分。have no doubt that=毫不怀疑。doubt的肯定句用whether/if（怀疑是否），否定句/疑问句用that（不怀疑）。no doubt→that。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法辨析：have no doubt that vs doubt whether（肯定vs否定）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我毫不怀疑他会成功。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I would rather read a book ___ watch TV.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我宁愿看书也不看电视。
questions.explanation: would rather...than...=宁愿...也不...。固定结构，rather和than搭配。would rather do A than do B=宁愿做A不做B。read a book=看书，watch TV=看电视。rather在前than在后，连接两个并列动词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：would rather...than...（宁愿...也不...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我宁愿看书也不看电视。

questions.question: Combine using a non-restrictive relative clause: Einstein developed the theory of relativity. He was a great scientist.
questions.questionCn: 用非限制性定语从句合并：爱因斯坦提出了相对论。他是一位伟大的科学家。
questions.answer: Einstein, who was a great scientist, developed the theory of relativity.
questions.explanation: 用who引导非限制性定语从句，逗号隔开补充说明Einstein。who was a great scientist=他是一位伟大的科学家。非限制性定语从句用逗号隔开，补充说明先行词，不能用that。who指人，逗号隔开=非限制性。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：非限制性定语从句who（逗号隔开，不能用that）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 爱因斯坦是一位伟大的科学家，他提出了相对论。

questions.question: Rewrite using mixed conditional (错综时间虚拟): If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
questions.questionCn: 用错综时间虚拟改写：如果我当初学医了，我现在就是一名医生了。
questions.answer: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
questions.explanation: 错综时间虚拟条件句：if从句与过去相反（had studied），主句与现在相反（would be）。条件发生在过去（当初学医），结果发生在现在（现在是医生）。从句用had done（过去），主句用would+原形（现在）。两半时态不同=错综虚拟。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：错综时间条件句（if+had done，主句would+原形）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我当初学医了，我现在就是一名医生了。

questions.question: Translate using inversion with 'Under no circumstances': 你绝不能向任何人透露这个秘密。
questions.questionCn: 用Under no circumstances倒装翻译：你绝不能向任何人透露这个秘密。
questions.answer: Under no circumstances should you reveal the secret to anyone.
questions.explanation: Under no circumstances=绝不能，否定短语放句首时部分倒装（情态动词should提前）。结构：Under no circumstances+助/情/be+主语+动词原形。should you reveal=你应该透露（倒装）。否定短语放句首→部分倒装。reveal sth to sb=向某人透露某事。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：否定短语Under no circumstances放句首倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你绝不能向任何人透露这个秘密。

questions.passage: Having been informed of the delay, the passengers waited patiently. The flight, scheduled for 9 AM, was delayed due to bad weather. Frustrated by the long wait, some passengers complained to the staff. The airline, having apologized for the inconvenience, offered free meals. With the weather improving, the flight was expected to take off soon. The passengers, encouraged by the news, felt much better. By the time the plane finally departed, everyone had been waiting for over three hours.
questions.passageCn: 得知延误后，乘客们耐心等待。原定上午9点的航班因恶劣天气延误。长时间等待让一些乘客向工作人员投诉。航空公司为不便道了歉并提供了免费餐食。随着天气好转，航班预计很快起飞。乘客们受到这个消息的鼓舞，感觉好多了。等飞机最终起飞时，大家已经等了三个多小时。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'Having been informed of the delay'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'Having been informed of the delay'使用了什么结构？
choices: B. Perfect participle passive (having been done)
subQuestions.explanation: Having been informed是现在分词完成式被动（having been+过去分词），表先于主句的被动动作。passengers与inform是被动关系（乘客被通知），且先于waited（先通知再等待）。having been done=完成式被动，表先于主句的被动动作。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：having been done完成式被动（先于主句的被动动作）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 得知延误后，乘客们耐心等待。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Frustrated by the long wait' is an active participle phrase.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Frustrated by the long wait'是主动分词短语。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。Frustrated是过去分词，表被动（乘客被沮丧），不是主动。主语passengers与frustrate是被动关系（被等待搞得沮丧）。过去分词表被动/完成，现在分词表主动/进行。Frustrated by=被...沮丧。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：过去分词Frustrated表被动（被沮丧）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 长时间等待让一些乘客向工作人员投诉。

subQuestions.question: What does 'With the weather improving' express?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'With the weather improving'表达了什么？
choices: B. An independent structure with active meaning
subQuestions.explanation: With+n.+现在分词=独立主格结构表主动正在进行。weather与improve是主动关系（天气好转），用现在分词improving。With+n.+doing表主动/进行；With+n.+done表被动/完成；With+n.+to do表将来。天气主动好转→improving。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：With+n.+doing独立主格表主动进行
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 随着天气好转，航班预计很快起飞。

questions.passage: If the scientist had published his findings earlier, many lives would have been saved. Had he not been so modest, he would have received the Nobel Prize sooner. It is high time that the scientific community recognized his contribution. The committee insists that he be awarded a special honor. Without his discovery, thousands of patients would still be suffering today. He wishes he had made the discovery even earlier, for more lives could have been saved.
questions.passageCn: 如果这位科学家早些发表他的发现，许多生命就会被拯救。要不是他那么谦虚，他早就能获得诺贝尔奖了。科学界早该认识到他的贡献了。委员会坚持授予他特别荣誉。要没有他的发现，今天成千上万的病人仍将受苦。他希望自己能更早做出这个发现，因为更多生命就能被拯救。

subQuestions.question: What type of conditional is used in 'If the scientist had published...many lives would have been saved'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'If the scientist had published...many lives would have been saved'使用了什么条件句？
subQuestions.explanation: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句：if从句had done（had published），主句would have done（would have been saved）。两半都与过去相反。past unreal conditional=与过去相反的虚拟。结构：if+had done，主句would have done。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：与过去相反的条件句if+had done，主句would have done
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 如果这位科学家早些发表他的发现，许多生命就会被拯救。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Had he not been so modest' is an inverted conditional without 'if'.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Had he not been so modest'是省略if的倒装条件句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。Had he not been so modest=If he had not been so modest，省略if后had提前倒装。与过去相反的虚拟条件句省if时had提前。否定形式Had he not been=If he had not been。省略if+had提前=虚拟倒装。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：条件句省略if，had提前倒装（否定形式）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是他那么谦虚，他早就能获得诺贝尔奖了。

subQuestions.question: What mood is used in 'the committee insists that he be awarded'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'the committee insists that he be awarded'使用了什么语气？
subQuestions.explanation: insist后的宾语从句用虚拟语气should+动词原形，should可省。be awarded是be的原形被动（be+过去分词awarded）。insist/suggest/demand/recommend等动词后从句用(should)+动词原形。be用原形不用is/was。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：insist后从句用(should)+动词原形被动
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 委员会坚持授予他特别荣誉。

questions.passage: The harder you work, the luckier you get. No sooner had the researcher published his paper than it was cited by hundreds of scholars. Scarcely had the news spread when invitations poured in from around the world. The more he was recognized, the more humble he became. He would rather spend time in the lab than attend social events. Try as he might to explain his theory, few people understood it at first. It was not until years later that his work was fully appreciated.
questions.passageCn: 你越努力，就越幸运。这位研究者刚发表论文，就被数百位学者引用。消息刚传开，世界各地的邀请就蜂拥而至。他越受认可，就越谦虚。他宁愿在实验室度过时光也不愿参加社交活动。尽管他努力解释自己的理论，起初很少有人理解。直到多年以后，他的工作才被充分认可。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'The harder you work, the luckier you get'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'The harder you work, the luckier you get'使用了什么结构？
choices: B. The+比较级..., the+比较级...
subQuestions.explanation: The+比较级..., the+比较级...=越...越...。The harder you work=你越努力，the luckier you get=你越幸运。两个the+比较级对应，表两事物同向变化。hard→harder（比较级），lucky→luckier（比较级）。固定结构。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：The+比较级..., the+比较级...（越...越...）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 你越努力，就越幸运。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'No sooner had the researcher published his paper than it was cited' uses correct structure.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'No sooner had the researcher published his paper than it was cited'使用了正确结构。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。No sooner...than...=一...就...，No sooner放句首时部分倒装（had提前）。had the researcher published=研究者发表了。than引出后句。注意搭配：No sooner+than（不用when），Hardly/Scarcely+when（不用than）。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...（一...就...，倒装）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 这位研究者刚发表论文，就被数百位学者引用。

subQuestions.question: What does 'Try as he might to explain' mean?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'Try as he might to explain'是什么意思？
subQuestions.explanation: Try as he might=Although he might try，as引导让步状语从句用倒装：动词原形+as+主语+助动词。Try as he might to explain=尽管他努力解释。as=although/though但语序特殊。动词原形Try放as前表让步。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：as让步倒装Try as we might=although
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 尽管他努力解释自己的理论，起初很少有人理解。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The professor, together with his students, ___ published a groundbreaking paper.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：这位教授和他的学生们一起发表了一篇开创性的论文。
questions.explanation: 主语是the professor（单数），together with his students是附加成分不影响主语数。主谓一致：主语+together with/along with/as well as+名词时，谓语动词与前面的主语一致。professor是单数，用has。together with不改变主语的数，区别于and（and连接时用复数）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：together with不影响主语数，谓语与前主语一致
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这位教授和他的学生们一起发表了一篇开创性的论文。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The meeting ___ over, everyone went home.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：会议结束后，大家都回家了。
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构：名词+having been+过去分词/形容词，表示先于主句动作完成的状态。The meeting having been over=会议结束后（会议已结束）。having been over表示完成。独立主格有自己的逻辑主语（the meeting），与主句主语（everyone）不同。being over表同时，having been over表先于。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格The meeting having been over（完成状态）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 会议结束后，大家都回家了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Without your help, I ___ the task on time.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果没有你的帮助，我就不能按时完成任务了。
questions.explanation: Without your help是含蓄虚拟条件（if的省略），表示与过去事实相反的假设（实际有帮助）。与过去相反用would have+过去分词。Without=If it had not been for，表'如果不是因为'。含蓄虚拟不用if，通过介词短语暗示条件。wouldn't have finished=就不会完成（实际完成了）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：含蓄虚拟Without+名词，与过去相反用would have+done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果没有你的帮助，我就不能按时完成任务了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ should you give up when facing difficulties.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：面对困难时，你决不应该放弃。
questions.explanation: In no case放句首引起部分倒装（should提前）。In no case=决不，是否定短语。否定短语放句首→部分倒装：助动词/情态动词+主语。should you give up=你应该放弃（倒装）。正常语序：You should give up in no case. In any case=无论如何，In case=万一，In that case=那样的话。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：In no case放句首引起部分倒装should+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 面对困难时，你决不应该放弃。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It ___ that the new policy will benefit millions of people.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：人们普遍认为新政策将惠及数百万人。
questions.explanation: 学术写作常用被动语态表达客观性。It is widely believed that...=人们普遍认为...，it是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。被动语态避免主观色彩，强调信息而非信息来源。is believed表状态（被相信），widely修饰believed。学术写作偏好被动语态和形式主语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术写作：It is widely believed that+从句（被动表达客观）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 人们普遍认为新政策将惠及数百万人。

questions.question: Choose the correct interpretation: 'I saw the man with the telescope' is ambiguous because:
questions.questionCn: 选择正确解释：'I saw the man with the telescope'有歧义，因为：
choices: B. 'With the telescope' can modify 'saw' or 'the man'
questions.explanation: 介词短语with the telescope可修饰saw（用望远镜看）或the man（拿望远镜的人），造成结构歧义。语法歧义包括：结构歧义（修饰关系不明确）、指代歧义（代词指代不明）、词汇歧义（一词多义）。此句是结构歧义，with短语修饰对象不明确。消除歧义需调整语序或补充信息。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：介词短语修饰对象不明确造成结构歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我看到了那个拿着望远镜的男人。/我用望远镜看到了那个男人。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ rich one may be, one cannot buy happiness.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：一个人无论多富有，都买不到幸福。
questions.explanation: However+形容词/副词+主语+谓语=无论多么...，引导让步状语从句。However rich=无论多富有。However是副词，后接形容词/副词。No matter how+形容词也可，但However更正式。Although引导让步从句不用倒装结构。However rich one may be=No matter how rich one may be。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：However+adj+主语+谓语（无论多么...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 一个人无论多富有，都买不到幸福。

questions.question: Choose the best translation: 直到他昨天回来我才知道这个消息。
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳翻译：直到他昨天回来我才知道这个消息。
choices: A. I didn't know the news until he came back yesterday.
B. Until he came back yesterday I knew the news.
C. Not until yesterday he came back I knew the news.
D. I knew the news until he came back yesterday.
questions.explanation: not...until...=直到...才...，否定主句。I didn't know...until he came back=直到他回来我才知道。B和D语序错误。C选项Not until放句首应倒装：Not until he came back yesterday did I know the news。not...until是固定结构，until后接时间点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与句型转换：not...until...=直到...才...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到他昨天回来我才知道这个消息。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The number of students who has passed the exam is increasing.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：通过考试的学生人数正在增加。
questions.explanation: 错误。先行词students是复数，定语从句谓语应用have不是has。但主句主语是The number（单数），is increasing是正确的。正确：The number of students who have passed the exam is increasing. 定语从句谓语与先行词students一致用have，主句谓语与The number一致用is。the number of+复数名词，谓语用单数。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：定语从句谓语与先行词students一致用have
questions.sentenceTranslation: 通过考试的学生人数正在增加。

questions.question: Judge true or false: There being no bus, we had to walk home.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：因为没有公交车，我们只好步行回家。
questions.explanation: 正确。There being no bus是独立主格结构（There be的独立主格形式），作原因状语。being是现在分词，no bus是逻辑主语。独立主格=自己的主语+分词，与主句主语不同。There being no bus=Because there was no bus。There be的独立主格形式是There being。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：There being独立主格作原因状语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 因为没有公交车，我们只好步行回家。

questions.question: Judge true or false: If he had followed my advice yesterday, he would be fine now.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：如果他昨天听了我的建议，他现在就会没事了。
questions.explanation: 正确。这是错综时间虚拟语气：if从句与过去相反（had followed），主句与现在相反（would be fine now）。错综时间虚拟：条件与结果发生时间不同，各自用对应时态。if从句had done表过去虚拟，主句would+原形表现在虚拟。yesterday暗示过去，now暗示现在。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：错综时间虚拟，if+had done（过去），主句would+原形（现在）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他昨天听了我的建议，他现在就会没事了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Were I you, I would accept the offer.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：如果我是你，我会接受这个提议。
questions.explanation: 正确。这是虚拟条件句的倒装省略形式：省略if，were提前到主语前。Were I you=If I were you，与现在相反的虚拟语气。虚拟条件句省略if时，had/were/should提前到主语前形成倒装。正式文体中常用此结构。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：虚拟条件句省if，were提前倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我是你，我会接受这个提议。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It is of great ___ that we protect the environment.
questions.questionCn: 填空：保护环境非常重要。
questions.explanation: It is of+抽象名词+that从句=...很重要，学术写作常用结构。of+抽象名词=形容词含义，of great importance=greatly important。名词化是学术写作特点，用名词代替形容词使表达更正式。importance是important的名词形式。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术写作：of+抽象名词=形容词（of importance=important）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 保护环境非常重要。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Rather than ___ (complain) about the problem, we should find a solution.
questions.questionCn: 填空：与其抱怨问题，我们应该找到解决方案。
questions.explanation: rather than后接动词原形，表示'而不是'。rather than complain=而不是抱怨。rather than连接两个并列动作，后接动词原形。rather than=instead of，但rather than后接原形，instead of后接动名词。We should find a solution=我们应该找到解决方案。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：rather than+动词原形（而不是）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 与其抱怨问题，我们应该找到解决方案。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The day will come ___ we can travel to Mars.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们能去火星旅行的那一天终将到来。
questions.explanation: when引导定语从句修饰the day，关系副词when在从句中作时间状语。The day when...=...的那一天。先行词the day表时间，用关系副词when。when=on which（on that day）。定语从句与先行词被will come分隔，是分隔定语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：when引导分隔定语从句修饰the day
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们能去火星旅行的那一天终将到来。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I would rather you ___ (not tell) him the truth yesterday.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我宁愿你昨天没有告诉他真相。
questions.explanation: would rather后接从句时用虚拟语气。与过去事实相反用had done，否定用had not+过去分词。would rather+主语+had done=宁愿某人过去做过/没做过某事。yesterday暗示过去，用过去完成时虚拟。tell的过去分词是told。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：would rather+从句用had done（与过去相反）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我宁愿你昨天没有告诉他真相。

questions.question: Rewrite in passive voice: People say that he is a genius.
questions.questionCn: 用被动语态改写：人们说他是个天才。
questions.answer: It is said that he is a genius.
questions.explanation: 两种被动改写方式：1) It is said that+从句（形式主语）；2) 主语+is said to+不定式。It is said that he is a genius=据说他是天才。He is said to be a genius=他被说是天才。学术写作常用此被动结构表达传闻。It是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与句型转换：People say that→It is said that / S+is said to do
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他是个天才。

questions.question: Combine using an absolute structure: The weather was fine. We decided to go hiking.
questions.questionCn: 用独立主格结构合并：天气很好。我们决定去远足。
questions.answer: The weather being fine, we decided to go hiking.
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构：名词+现在分词，作原因状语。The weather being fine=天气很好（因为天气好）。独立主格有自己的逻辑主语（the weather），与主句主语（we）不同。weather和be是主动关系用现在分词being。独立主格=独立主语+分词，不作主句成分。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格名词+现在分词作原因状语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 天气很好，我们决定去远足。

questions.passage: Had I known the beauty of the Scottish Highlands, I would have visited them years ago. Rarely had I seen such breathtaking landscapes. Not only was the scenery magnificent, but the local culture was also fascinating. Scarcely had I arrived in Edinburgh when I fell in love with the city. So captivating was the scenery that I extended my trip by a week. Only after exploring the Highlands did I understand why they inspired so many poets. Never have I experienced such a memorable journey.
questions.passageCn: 如果我早知道苏格兰高地的美景，我多年前就会来参观了。我很少见过如此令人惊叹的风景。不仅景色壮丽，当地文化也令人着迷。我刚到爱丁堡就爱上了这座城市。风景如此迷人，以至于我把行程延长了一周。只有在探索了高地之后，我才理解为什么它启发了如此多的诗人。我从未有过如此难忘的旅程。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'Had I known the beauty of the Scottish Highlands'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'Had I known the beauty of the Scottish Highlands'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: Had I known=If I had known，省略if的虚拟条件句倒装。had提前到主语I之前。与过去事实相反的虚拟：if+had done，主句would have done。省略if时had/were/should提前倒装。正式文体常用此倒装省略结构。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：虚拟条件句省if，had提前倒装
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我早知道苏格兰高地的美景，我多年前就会来参观了。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'So captivating was the scenery' uses normal word order.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'So captivating was the scenery'使用了正常语序。
subQuestions.explanation: 错误。So+形容词放句首时部分倒装，be动词was提前到主语the scenery之前。正常语序：The scenery was so captivating that...。So...that=如此...以至于，So放句首倒装。部分倒装=be/助/情+主语。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：So+adj放句首引起部分倒装was+主语
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 风景如此迷人，以至于我把行程延长了一周。

questions.passage: If the university had offered more scholarships, many students would not have dropped out. It is essential that every student be given equal opportunities. The committee insisted that the admission policy be revised. Were it not for the student loan program, countless students would be unable to afford tuition. It is high time that the university reduced its tuition fees. Without financial aid, many talented students would have been denied education. It is crucial that these issues be addressed promptly.
questions.passageCn: 如果大学提供更多奖学金，许多学生就不会退学了。每个学生都应获得平等的机会，这是至关重要的。委员会坚持修改招生政策。如果不是因为有学生贷款项目，无数学生将无法负担学费。大学早就该降低学费了。如果没有经济援助，许多有才华的学生就会被拒绝接受教育。及时解决这些问题至关重要。

subQuestions.question: What mood is used in 'It is essential that every student be given equal opportunities'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'It is essential that every student be given equal opportunities'使用了什么语气？
subQuestions.explanation: It is essential that后用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。be given是被动虚拟(should be given的省略should)。essential/important/necessary/natural等形容词后的主语从句用虚拟语气(should)+原形。should可省略，be保持原形。这是虚拟语气的高阶用法。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：It is essential that+(should)+动词原形
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 每个学生都应获得平等的机会，这是至关重要的。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Were it not for the student loan program' is an inverted conditional clause with omitted 'if'.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Were it not for the student loan program'是省略if的倒装条件句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。Were it not for=If it were not for，省略if的虚拟条件句倒装。were提前到主语it之前。与现在事实相反的虚拟：if+were，主句would+原形。Were it not for=如果不是因为。正式文体常用此倒装结构。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：Were it not for=If it were not for（省if倒装）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 如果不是因为有学生贷款项目，无数学生将无法负担学费。

postgraduate.name: 考研
postgraduate.description: 考研英语核心语法+词汇：长难句分析、定语从句嵌套、非谓语独立主格、虚拟语气、倒装强调、熟词僻义与翻译技巧，以真题风格提升应试能力。
focus: 定语从句嵌套与分隔
非谓语动词与独立主格
虚拟语气与倒装强调
名词性从句综合
长难句拆分与理解
考研高频词汇与熟词僻义
翻译技巧：长难句翻译

questions.question: The book, ___ the cover is blue, was written by a famous author who won the Nobel Prize.
questions.questionCn: 那本封面是蓝色的书是由一位获得诺贝尔奖的著名作家写的。
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句中of which的用法。the cover of which = whose cover，但本题中cover前有定冠词the，不能用whose（whose后直接跟名词，不加冠词）。of which the cover = the cover of which = whose cover。句子中还嵌套了另一个who引导的定语从句修饰author。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：of which表示所属关系 + 从句嵌套
questions.sentenceTranslation: 那本封面是蓝色的书是由一位获得诺贝尔奖的著名作家写的。

questions.question: ___ for a long time, the novel written by the unknown author became a bestseller overnight.
questions.questionCn: 被忽视了很长时间后，这位不知名作家写的小说一夜之间成了畅销书。
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在分词完成被动式作状语。逻辑主语the novel与ignore是被动关系，且ignore的动作发生在became之前（有for a long time说明时间先后），所以用现在分词完成被动式Having been ignored。Having been done = 被动 + 完成，作状语表示该动作发生在主句动作之前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：现在分词完成被动式作状语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 被忽视了很长时间后，这位不知名作家写的小说一夜之间成了畅销书。

questions.question: Not until he retired from teaching three years ago ___ having a holiday abroad.
questions.questionCn: 直到三年前从教学岗位上退休，他才考虑去国外度假。
questions.explanation: 本题考查not until引导的时间状语从句置于句首时的倒装。not until...置于句首时，主句要用部分倒装（助动词提前）。时态：从句用一般过去时（retired），主句动作发生在从句之后，也用一般过去时，所以用did he consider。否定词置于句首引起部分倒装是考研必考语法点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：not until置于句首的部分倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到三年前从教学岗位上退休，他才考虑去国外度假。

questions.question: It is strange that such a gentleman ___ be so rude to an old lady.
questions.questionCn: 真奇怪，这样一位绅士竟然对一位老太太如此粗鲁。
questions.explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气在主语从句中的用法。在It is strange/natural/important/necessary/essential that...句型中，that从句要用虚拟语气，谓语用should + 动词原形，should可以省略。这里should表示"竟然"，含有惊讶、意外的语气。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：It is strange that...句型中的should
questions.sentenceTranslation: 真奇怪，这样一位绅士竟然对一位老太太如此粗鲁。

questions.question: It was not until she had arrived home ___ she remembered her appointment with the doctor.
questions.questionCn: 直到她到家，她才想起和医生的预约。
questions.explanation: 本题考查强调句型。It is/was not until...that...是not until句型的强调形式，意思是"直到...才..."。判断强调句的方法：去掉It is/was...that...后，剩余部分可以组成完整句子。
questions.knowledgePoint: 强调句：It is/was not until...that...句型
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到她到家，她才想起和医生的预约。

questions.question: ___ we understand things has a lot to do with what we feel.
questions.questionCn: 我们理解事物的方式与我们的感受有很大关系。
questions.explanation: 本题考查主语从句的引导词。分析句子结构：___ we understand things是主语从句，从句中不缺少主语或宾语（we是主语，things是宾语），所以不用what。根据句意"我们理解事物的方式"，表示方式，所以用how引导主语从句。how在从句中作方式状语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词性从句：how引导主语从句（作方式状语）

vocabulary.word: have a lot to do with

questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们理解事物的方式与我们的感受有很大关系。

questions.question: The lecture ___, a lively question-and-answer session followed.
questions.questionCn: 讲座结束后，紧接着是生动的问答环节。
questions.explanation: 本题考查独立主格结构。句子的两部分主语不同（the lecture和a question-and-answer session），且没有连词连接，所以用独立主格结构。lecture与give是被动关系，且give的动作发生在followed之前，所以用having been given。独立主格结构：名词/代词 + 分词，在句中作状语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：独立主格结构（被动完成）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 讲座结束后，紧接着是生动的问答环节。

questions.question: The president of the World Bank says he has a passion for China, ___ he remembers starting as early as his childhood.
questions.questionCn: 世界银行行长说他对中国有着一份热爱，他记得这份热爱早在童年时期就开始了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查非限制性定语从句。先行词是a passion for China，关系词在从句中作remember的宾语，所以用which。句子结构较复杂：he remembers是插入语，which引导的定语从句中，which指代a passion。带有插入语的定语从句是考研难点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：带插入语的非限制性定语从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 世界银行行长说他对中国有着一份热爱，他记得这份热爱早在童年时期就开始了。

questions.question: If he ___ his doctor's advice, he wouldn't be in such a terrible situation now.
questions.questionCn: 如果他当初听从了医生的建议，现在就不会处于这么糟糕的境地了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查错综时间条件句（混合虚拟语气）。从句说的是过去的情况（如果当初听了医生建议），用had done；主句说的是现在的情况（现在不会这么糟糕），用would + 动词原形。这就是错综时间条件句——从句和主句的时间不一致。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：错综时间条件句（过去→现在）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他当初听从了医生的建议，现在就不会处于这么糟糕的境地了。

questions.question: Only when you can find peace in your heart ___ good relationships with others.
questions.questionCn: 只有当你内心找到平静时，你才能与他人保持良好的关系。
questions.explanation: 本题考查only + 状语从句置于句首时的倒装。only + 状语（从句/介词短语/副词）置于句首时，主句要用部分倒装。时态：从句用一般现在时表将来（can find），主句用一般将来时will keep。only置于句首的倒装是考研高频考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：only + 状语从句置于句首的部分倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 只有当你内心找到平静时，你才能与他人保持良好的关系。

questions.question: The manager put forward a suggestion ___ we should have an assistant. There is too much work to do.
questions.questionCn: 经理提出了一个建议：我们应该有一个助手。要做的工作太多了。
questions.explanation: 本题考查同位语从句。suggestion后面的从句是对suggestion内容的解释说明，是同位语从句。同位语从句用that引导，that在从句中不作成分，只起连接作用，不能省略。suggestion, advice, proposal, idea, fact, news, hope等后常跟同位语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词性从句：that引导同位语从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 经理提出了一个建议：我们应该有一个助手。

questions.question: ___ with such a difficult situation, the young man didn't give up and tried his best.
questions.questionCn: 面对如此困难的局面，这个年轻人没有放弃，而是尽了最大努力。
questions.explanation: 本题考查过去分词作状语。be faced with是固定搭配，意为"面对"。作状语时去掉be动词，用faced with...。注意：face sth. = be faced with sth.，但用法不同。facing such a difficult situation（主动：面临）也对，但facing后不能加with。本题有with，所以用faced。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：be faced with作状语时用faced with
questions.sentenceTranslation: 面对如此困难的局面，这个年轻人没有放弃，而是尽了最大努力。

questions.question: The course normally attracts 200 students per year, ___ up to half will be from overseas.
questions.questionCn: 这门课程通常每年吸引200名学生，其中多达一半来自海外。
questions.explanation: 本题考查非限制性定语从句中of whom/which表示部分与整体的关系。先行词是200 students（指人），所以用whom。up to half of whom = 其中多达一半的人。结构：数词/分数/百分数 + of + whom/which，表示"其中的..."。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：of whom表示部分与整体关系
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这门课程通常每年吸引200名学生，其中多达一半来自海外。

questions.question: ___ hard you try, it is difficult to lose weight without cutting down the amount you eat.
questions.questionCn: 无论你多么努力，不减少食量就很难减肥。
questions.explanation: 本题考查让步状语从句。however + 形容词/副词 = no matter how + 形容词/副词，意为"无论多么..."。however hard you try = no matter how hard you try（无论你多么努力）。whatever后接名词或不接；whichever表示"无论哪一个"；whenever表示"无论何时"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 状语从句：however引导让步状语从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 无论你多么努力，不减少食量就很难减肥。

questions.question: It was when we were returning home ___ I realized what a good feeling it was to have helped someone in trouble.
questions.questionCn: 正是在我们回家的时候，我才意识到帮助有困难的人是一种多么好的感觉。
questions.explanation: 本题考查强调句型。It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 其他部分。本题强调的是时间状语从句when we were returning home。判断方法：去掉It was...that...后句子仍然完整。注意：被强调部分是时间/地点状语时，不能用when/where，只能用that。
questions.knowledgePoint: 强调句：强调时间状语从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 正是在我们回家的时候，我才意识到帮助有困难的人是一种多么好的感觉。

questions.question: It remains to be seen ___ the newly formed committee's policy can be put into practice.
questions.questionCn: 新成立的委员会的政策能否付诸实施还有待观察。
questions.explanation: 本题考查主语从句。it是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的从句。根据句意"政策能否付诸实施还有待观察"，含有"是否"的含义，所以用whether引导主语从句。It remains to be seen whether...是考研高频句型，意为"...还有待观察/尚不确定"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词性从句：whether引导主语从句（it作形式主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 新成立的委员会的政策能否付诸实施还有待观察。

questions.question: The film star wears sunglasses. Therefore, he can go shopping without ___.
questions.questionCn: 这位影星戴着太阳镜。因此，他可以去购物而不被认出来。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动名词的被动式作介词宾语。without是介词，后面接动名词。主语he与recognize之间是被动关系（被认出），所以用动名词的被动式being recognized。having been recognized强调动作先于谓语动作发生，而本题只是一般性描述。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语动词：动名词被动式作介词宾语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这位影星戴着太阳镜。因此，他可以去购物而不被认出来。

questions.question: A lot of language learning, ___ has been discovered, is happening in the first year of life.
questions.questionCn: 正如发现的那样，大量的语言学习发生在出生后的第一年。
questions.explanation: 本题考查as引导的非限制性定语从句。as引导非限制性定语从句时，可以放在句首、句中或句末，意为"正如，正像"。as has been discovered = 正如所发现的那样。as指代整个主句的内容。which引导非限制性定语从句只能放在主句之后。as引导的定语从句常与known, said, reported, discovered等连用。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定语从句：as引导非限制性定语从句（正如）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 正如发现的那样，大量的语言学习发生在出生后的第一年。

questions.question: I wish I ___ at my sister's wedding last Tuesday, but I was on a business trip in New York.
questions.questionCn: 我真希望上周二参加了我姐姐的婚礼，但我当时在纽约出差。
questions.explanation: 本题考查wish引导的宾语从句中的虚拟语气。wish后的宾语从句用虚拟语气：对现在虚拟用过去时，对过去虚拟用过去完成时（had done），对将来虚拟用would/could/might + do。本题中last Tuesday表示过去时间，所以用过去完成时had been。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：wish从句对过去情况的虚拟（had done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我真希望上周二参加了我姐姐的婚礼，但我当时在纽约出差。

questions.question: His idea was such a good one ___ we all agreed to use it.
questions.questionCn: 他的主意太好了，我们都同意采用。
questions.explanation: 本题考查结果状语从句。such...that...引导结果状语从句，意为"如此...以至于..."。结构：such + a/an + adj. + 可数名词单数 + that从句。注意区分such...as...（as引导定语从句，as在从句中作成分）和such...that...（that引导结果状语从句，that在从句中不作成分）。本题从句主谓宾完整，所以用that。
questions.knowledgePoint: 状语从句：such...that...引导结果状语从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他的主意太好了，我们都同意采用。

questions.question: The team's success has ___ his reputation as a great coach.
questions.questionCn: 球队的成功___了他作为伟大教练的声誉。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。enhance意为"提高，增强（价值、质量、声望等）"，enhance reputation即"提高声誉"。enlarge意为"扩大（尺寸、面积等）"；expand意为"扩张，扩展（范围、规模）"；extend意为"延伸，延长（时间、距离）"。这四个近义词是考研完形高频考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：enhance/enlarge/expand/extend 近义词辨析
questions.sentenceTranslation: 球队的成功提升了他作为伟大教练的声誉。

questions.question: The old building has been ___ restored to its original beauty.
questions.questionCn: 这座老建筑已被___修复到原来的美丽状态。
questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。faithfully意为"忠实地，如实地"，faithfully restored即"原汁原味地修复"。officially意为"官方地"；physically意为"身体上；物理上"；regularly意为"定期地"。faithfully是考研高频词，还有"衷心地"的意思（Yours faithfully 敬上）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 副词辨析：faithfully多义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这座老建筑已被原汁原味地修复到原来的美丽状态。

questions.question: The government has adopted a new ___ to solving the housing problem.
questions.questionCn: 政府采取了一种新的___来解决住房问题。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。这四个词都有"方法"的意思，但搭配不同：approach to (doing) sth.（to是介词）；method of/for (doing) sth.；means of (doing) sth.；way of doing sth./to do sth.。本题后面有to solving，所以用approach。approach还有"接近，途径"的意思，是考研熟词僻义考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：approach/method/means/way 方法类名词搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 政府采取了一种新的方法来解决住房问题。

questions.question: It took him several months to ___ the wild horse.
questions.questionCn: 他花了几个月时间才___这匹野马。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。tame作动词意为"驯服，驯化"，tame the wild horse即"驯服野马"。tame作形容词意为"温顺的，驯服的"。cultivate意为"培养；耕作"；breed意为"繁殖；饲养"；tend意为"照料；倾向于"（tend to）。tame是考研高频词，尤其是其动词含义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：tame/cultivate/breed/tend
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他花了几个月时间才驯服了这匹野马。

questions.question: The rising unemployment rate is a major ___ for the new government.
questions.questionCn: 不断上升的失业率是新政府面临的主要___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。concern作名词意为"关心的事，担忧的事"，a major concern即"一个主要担忧的问题"。concern作动词意为"涉及；使担忧"，也是考研高频词。campaign意为"运动，活动"；conflict意为"冲突，矛盾"；consequence意为"后果，结果"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：concern多义（关注/担忧）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 不断上升的失业率是新政府面临的主要担忧。

questions.question: When the boss came in, all the employees tried to ___ their work quickly.
questions.questionCn: 老板进来时，所有员工都试图快速___工作。
questions.explanation: 本题考查get相关动词短语。get down to (doing) sth.意为"开始认真做某事，着手做某事"，to是介词，后面接名词或动名词。get on with意为"继续做；与...相处"；get along with意为"与...相处融洽"；get away with意为"（做错事）侥幸逃脱"。get短语是考研完形最高频考点之一。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词短语辨析：get相关短语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 老板进来时，所有员工都试图快速开始认真工作。

questions.question: The two theories are ___ different from each other, though they sound similar.
questions.questionCn: 这两种理论虽然听起来相似，但本质上是不同的。
questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。fundamentally意为"根本上，本质上"，fundamentally different即"根本不同"。frequently意为"频繁地"；fortunately意为"幸运地"；fluently意为"流利地"。fundamental作形容词意为"基本的，根本的"，作名词意为"基本原理"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 副词辨析：fundamentally多义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这两种理论虽然听起来相似，但本质上是不同的。

questions.question: The company is looking for people with ___ experience in this field.
questions.questionCn: 公司正在寻找在这个领域有___经验的人。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。previous意为"以前的，先前的"，previous experience即"以前的经验，工作经验"，是招聘场景的常见表达。precious意为"珍贵的"；precise意为"精确的"；primary意为"主要的；初级的"。pre-开头的形容词是考研完形易混词。
