questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词辨析：pre-开头易混形容词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 公司正在寻找在这个领域有过往经验的人。

questions.question: The doctor warned him not to ___ himself to more stress.
questions.questionCn: 医生警告他不要让自己___更多压力。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。expose意为"暴露，使处于...影响下"，expose oneself to sth.是固定搭配，意为"使自己暴露于..."。expose还有"揭露，曝光"的意思，是考研熟词僻义考点。impose意为"强加"（impose sth. on sb.）；compose意为"组成；作曲"；dispose意为"处理"（dispose of）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：expose及其固定搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 医生警告他不要让自己承受更多压力。

questions.question: The author's description is so ___ that I can almost see the scene.
questions.questionCn: 作者的描述太___了，我几乎能看到那个场景。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。vivid意为"生动的，逼真的"，vivid description即"生动的描述"。vague意为"模糊的"；valid意为"有效的，有根据的"；vain意为"徒劳的；虚荣的"（in vain 徒劳）。v-开头的形容词是考研完形易混词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词辨析：v-开头易混形容词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 作者的描述太生动了，我几乎能看到那个场景。

questions.question: The new policy will ___ millions of people living in poverty.
questions.questionCn: 新政策将___数百万生活在贫困中的人。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析和形近词。affect是动词，意为"影响"。effect作名词意为"影响，效果"（have an effect on），作动词意为"实现，产生"（effect changes 带来改变）。afford意为"负担得起"；effort是名词，意为"努力"。affect和effect是考研最常考的形近词之一。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：affect vs effect 形近词辨析
questions.sentenceTranslation: 新政策将影响数百万生活在贫困中的人。

questions.question: There is a growing ___ that the problem cannot be solved by military means alone.
questions.questionCn: 人们越来越___这个问题不能仅靠军事手段解决。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。recognition意为"认识，认可；识别"，a growing recognition that...即"越来越多的人认识到..."。reception意为"接待；接收"；reservation意为"预订；保留意见"；recreation意为"娱乐，消遣"。-tion结尾的名词是考研完形高频考点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：-tion结尾易混名词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 人们越来越认识到这个问题不能仅靠军事手段解决。

questions.question: The old rules no longer ___. We need to make new ones.
questions.questionCn: 旧规则不再___。我们需要制定新的规则。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。apply意为"适用；申请；应用"，这里表示"适用，有效"，是考研熟词僻义。approve意为"批准；赞成"（approve of）；appeal意为"呼吁；吸引；上诉"（appeal to）；appoint意为"任命；约定"。apply的多义性尤其重要。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：apply多义（适用/申请/应用）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 旧规则不再适用。我们需要制定新的规则。

questions.question: The report is highly ___ of the police's handling of the incident.
questions.questionCn: 这份报告对警方处理这一事件的方式提出了强烈___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。critical意为"批评的；关键的"，be critical of是固定搭配，意为"对...提出批评"。criminal意为"犯罪的"；crucial意为"至关重要的"（be crucial to/for）；curious意为"好奇的"（be curious about）。critical的两个意思都是考研重点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词辨析：critical多义（批评的/关键的）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这份报告对警方处理这一事件的方式提出了强烈批评。

questions.question: The study found a direct ___ between stress and heart disease.
questions.questionCn: 研究发现压力和心脏病之间有直接___。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。correlation意为"相关性，关联"，a direct correlation between A and B即"A和B之间的直接关联"。cooperation意为"合作"；combination意为"结合，组合"；comprehension意为"理解"。co-/com-开头的名词是考研完形易混词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：co-/com-开头易混名词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 研究发现压力和心脏病之间有直接关联。

questions.question: The committee will ___ your suggestion carefully before making a decision.
questions.questionCn: 委员会将在做出决定前仔细___你的建议。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。consider意为"考虑；认为"，consider your suggestion carefully即"仔细考虑你的建议"。consist意为"由...组成"（consist of）；confirm意为"确认，证实"；conclude意为"得出结论；结束"。con-开头的动词是考研完形最高频考点之一。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：con-开头易混动词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 委员会将在做出决定前仔细考虑你的建议。

questions.question: The professor is ___ to all his students, always willing to help them.
questions.questionCn: 这位教授对所有学生都很___，总是愿意帮助他们。
questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。accessible意为"易接近的，可接触到的"，be accessible to sb.表示"对某人来说是可接近的/平易近人的"。accessible还有"可访问的，可使用的"意思。acceptable意为"可接受的"；advisable意为"明智的，可取的"；available意为"可用的，有空的"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词辨析：-ible/-able结尾易混形容词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这位教授对所有学生都很平易近人，总是愿意帮助他们。

questions.question: The scientist's discovery has ___ new possibilities for medical research.
questions.questionCn: 这位科学家的发现为医学研究___了新的可能性。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。open up意为"打开；开创，开辟"，open up new possibilities即"开辟新的可能性"。put up意为"举起；张贴；建造"；take up意为"开始从事；占据"；make up意为"组成；编造；弥补"。up短语是考研完形最高频考点之一。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词短语辨析：up相关短语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这位科学家的发现为医学研究开辟了新的可能性。

questions.question: She was overcome with ___ when she heard the bad news.
questions.questionCn: 听到这个坏消息时，她被___所淹没。
questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。grief意为"悲伤，悲痛"，be overcome with grief即"悲痛欲绝"。guilt意为"内疚，罪行"；grace意为"优雅；恩典"；grade意为"年级；等级"。be overcome with是固定搭配，意为"被...所压倒/充满"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词辨析：g-开头易混名词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 听到这个坏消息时，她悲痛欲绝。

questions.question: The museum has ___ several priceless paintings from a private collection.
questions.questionCn: 博物馆从一个私人收藏中___了几幅无价的画作。
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。acquire意为"获得，取得（多指通过努力逐步获得）"。inquire意为"询问，调查"；require意为"需要，要求"；admire意为"钦佩，欣赏"。-quire结尾的动词是考研完形易混词。acquire还有"习得（知识/技能）"的意思。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动词辨析：-quire结尾易混动词 + acquire多义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 博物馆从一个私人收藏中获得了几幅无价的画作。

questions.question: Choose the best Chinese translation of: 'It is not that I don't want to go, but that I have no time.'
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳中文翻译：'It is not that I don't want to go, but that I have no time.'
choices: A. 不是我不想去，而是我没有时间。
B. 我不想去是因为我没有时间。
C. 我没有时间所以我不想去。
D. 不是因为我没时间，而是我不想去。
questions.explanation: 本题考查not that...but that...句型的翻译。not that...but that...是固定结构，意为"不是因为...而是因为..."，相当于not because...but because...。翻译时要注意语序和逻辑关系，不能颠倒。这是考研翻译中的常见句型。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译技巧：not that...but that...句型翻译
questions.sentenceTranslation: 不是我不想去，而是我没有时间。

questions.question: Choose the best Chinese translation of: 'The book, which was published last year, has been translated into several languages.'
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳中文翻译：'The book, which was published last year, has been translated into several languages.'
choices: A. 这本去年出版的书已经被翻译成了好几种语言。
B. 这本书去年出版，被翻译成好几种语言。
C. 出版于去年的这本书，翻译了好几种语言。
D. 去年出版的书已经翻译成好几种语言了。

questions.passage: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the world of work, and the legal profession is no exception. A growing number of law firms are now using AI tools to handle routine tasks such as document review, legal research, and contract analysis. Proponents argue that AI can significantly improve efficiency, reduce costs, and free up lawyers to focus on more complex and strategic work. However, critics warn that the widespread adoption of AI in law could lead to significant job losses, particularly for junior lawyers and paralegals who perform many of the tasks that AI can automate. They also raise ethical concerns about algorithmic bias and the potential for AI to make mistakes that could have serious legal consequences. Despite these concerns, the trend toward AI in law appears unstoppable. According to a recent report, the global legal AI market is expected to grow by more than 30 percent annually over the next five years. The key challenge for the legal profession will be to find ways to integrate AI technology responsibly while ensuring that it serves the interests of justice.
questions.passageCn: 人工智能正在迅速改变职场，法律行业也不例外。越来越多的律师事务所现在使用人工智能工具来处理文件审查、法律研究和合同分析等日常任务。支持者认为，人工智能可以显著提高效率、降低成本，并让律师腾出时间专注于更复杂和战略性的工作。然而，批评者警告说，人工智能在法律领域的广泛采用可能导致大量失业，特别是对于初级律师和律师助理而言，他们所做的许多工作都可以被人工智能自动化。他们还提出了关于算法偏见以及人工智能可能犯错从而产生严重法律后果的伦理担忧。尽管存在这些担忧，法律行业人工智能化的趋势似乎不可阻挡。根据最近的一份报告，全球法律人工智能市场预计在未来五年内每年增长超过30%。法律行业面临的关键挑战将是找到负责任地整合人工智能技术的方法，同时确保它服务于正义的利益。

questions.passage: The concept of work-life balance has gained increasing attention in recent years as people recognize the importance of maintaining a healthy equilibrium between their professional and personal lives. However, achieving this balance remains a significant challenge for many, particularly in cultures that prioritize work over personal well-being. In some East Asian countries, for example, long working hours and intense workplace competition have led to widespread concerns about burnout and mental health issues. The term 'karoshi' (death from overwork) originated in Japan and has become a symbol of the extreme pressure faced by workers. In response to these challenges, some companies have implemented policies to promote work-life balance, such as flexible working hours, remote work options, and mandatory vacation time. Governments have also introduced regulations to limit overtime and protect workers' rights. Critics argue, however, that such measures are often superficial and fail to address the underlying cultural values that drive overwork. They maintain that real change requires a fundamental shift in societal attitudes toward work and success. Only when people begin to value their personal lives as much as their professional achievements can a genuine work-life balance be achieved.
questions.passageCn: 近年来，随着人们认识到在职业生活和个人生活之间保持健康平衡的重要性，工作与生活平衡这一概念日益受到关注。然而，实现这种平衡对许多人来说仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是在那些将工作置于个人福祉之上的文化中。例如，在一些东亚国家，长时间的工作和激烈的职场竞争导致了人们对职业倦怠和心理健康问题的普遍担忧。"过劳死"一词起源于日本，已成为工人面临极端压力的象征。为了应对这些挑战，一些公司实施了促进工作与生活平衡的政策，如弹性工作时间、远程办公选择和强制休假。政府也出台了限制加班、保护工人权益的法规。然而，批评者认为，这些措施往往流于表面，未能解决导致过度工作的深层文化价值观。他们坚持认为，真正的改变需要社会对工作和成功的态度发生根本性转变。只有当人们开始像重视职业成就一样重视个人生活时，才能实现真正的工作与生活平衡。

subQuestions.question: The sentence 'Only when people begin to value their personal lives as much as their professional achievements can a genuine work-life balance be achieved' uses which grammatical structure?
subQuestions.questionCn: 句子'Only when people begin to value...can a genuine work-life balance be achieved'使用了什么语法结构？
subQuestions.explanation: 本题考查句子结构分析。这个句子同时使用了两种语法结构：1) 倒装结构：Only + 状语从句置于句首时，主句用部分倒装（can a genuine work-life balance be achieved）；2) 被动语态：a genuine work-life balance be achieved（平衡被实现）。所以D选项正确。这是考研长难句分析的典型考点——多重语法结构叠加。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 长难句分析：only倒装 + 被动语态
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 只有当人们开始像重视职业成就一样重视个人生活时，才能实现真正的工作与生活平衡。
